requires = ["hatchling>=1.32.4"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"



[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/lib_layered_config"]
include = ["src/lib_layered_config/py.typed"]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
target-version = "py310"
extend-exclude = [
  "notebooks/Quickstart.ipynb",
  "tests/benchmark",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
  "E", "W",     # pycodestyle
  "F",           # pyflakes
  "I",           # isort
  "N",           # pep8-naming
  "UP",          # pyupgrade
  "B",           # bugbear
  "A",           # builtins shadowing
  "C4",          # comprehension simplification
  "SIM",         # simplification
  "TCH",         # type-checking imports
  "RUF",         # ruff-specific
  "G",           # logging format (catches f-string in logger)
  "T20",         # print statements
  "PTH",         # pathlib preference
  "PLC", "PLE",  # pylint conventions/errors
  "S",           # flake8-bandit security checks
  "PERF",        # performance anti-patterns
  "ERA",         # eradicate dead/commented-out code
  "FBT",         # boolean trap (boolean positional args)
  "PLR",         # pylint refactor
  "PLW",         # pylint warnings
]

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "google"

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# ignore the "unused import sys" in the jupyter notebook - which we need (it is a linter hickup)
"notebooks/*.ipynb" = ["F401"]
"notebooks/Quickstart.ipynb" = ["E999"]
# Tests: assert is standard, test fixtures have passwords, magic values are clearer inline, temp
# paths are fine. PLC0415: local/deferred imports are a deliberate test idiom - several tests
# import inside the test body to exercise import-time and cache behaviour. PLR0911: a helper that
# mirrors a coercion chain under test reads clearest as one branch per case.
"tests/**/*.py" = ["S101", "S105", "S106", "S108", "T20", "PLR2004", "PLR0913", "PLR0911", "FBT001", "FBT003", "PLC0415"]
# These modules are the composition/orchestration layer: every function threads the same
# many named identifiers (vendor/app/slug/profile/prefer/start_dir/default_file/dotenv_path)
# or merge-recursion state (target/provenance/key/value/dotted/snapshot/segments) through
# keyword-only parameters by design; splitting them into a params object would be a real
# API/behaviour change, not a lint fix.
"src/lib_layered_config/core.py" = ["PLR0913"]
"src/lib_layered_config/_layers.py" = ["PLR0913"]
"src/lib_layered_config/application/merge.py" = ["PLR0913"]
"src/lib_layered_config/adapters/path_resolvers/default.py" = ["PLR0913"]
"src/lib_layered_config/cli/*.py" = ["PLR0913"]
"src/lib_layered_config/examples/*.py" = ["PLR0913"]

[tool.pyright]
typeCheckingMode = "strict"
include = [
  "src/lib_layered_config",
]
exclude = [
  "scripts/menu.py",
  "tests",
  "notebooks",
  "docs",
  "dist",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = ["--maxfail=1", "--no-cov", "--doctest-modules", "--ignore=scripts/menu.py", "--ignore=tests/benchmark"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
doctest_optionflags = ["ELLIPSIS", "NORMALIZE_WHITESPACE", "IGNORE_EXCEPTION_DETAIL"]
testpaths = ["tests", "src"]
python_files = ["tests/**/test_*.py"]
markers = [
  "slow: marks tests as slow (deselect with -m 'not slow')",
  "os_agnostic: executes on every supported operating system",
  "posix_only: requires POSIX semantics",
  "mac_only: requires macOS semantics",
  "windows_only: requires Windows semantics",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
parallel = false
data_file = "/tmp/.coverage.lib_layered_config"
source = ["src/lib_layered_config"]

[tool.coverage.report]
omit = [
  "tests/*",
  "tests/benchmark/*",
]
fail_under = 90
show_missing = true

[tool.clean]
# Patterns to remove when running `make clean`
patterns = [
  "**/__pycache__",
  ".hypothesis",
  ".import_linter_cache",
  ".pytest_cache",
  ".ruff_cache",
  ".pyright",
  ".mypy_cache",
  ".tox",
  ".nox",
  ".eggs",
  "*.egg-info",
  "build",
  "dist",
  "htmlcov",
  ".coverage",
  "coverage.xml",
  "codecov.sh",
  ".cache",
  "result",
]

[tool.git]
# Default git remote for push/release commands
default-remote = "origin"


[tool.scripts.test]
# Configuration for scripts/test.py test runner
pytest-verbosity = "-vv"
coverage-report-file = "coverage.xml"
src-path = "src"
[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "lib_layered_config"

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Clean architecture layers"
type = "layers"
containers = ["lib_layered_config"]
layers = [
  "cli",
  "examples",
  "adapters",
  "application",
  "domain",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No adapters in domain"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["lib_layered_config.domain"]
forbidden_modules = ["lib_layered_config.adapters", "lib_layered_config.application", "lib_layered_config.core"]

[tool.pip-audit]
# Known vulnerabilities to ignore (unfixable or accepted risk)
ignore-vulns = []

[tool.uv]
exclude-newer = "7 days"
exclude-newer-package = {lib-cli-exit-tools = false, hypothesis = "2026-10-16T16:46:42Z", ruff = "2026-10-15T15:23:19Z"}

# ────────────────────────────────────────
[tool.ruff]

target-version = "py312"
src = ["src"]            # First-party code layout

    ".bzr",
    ".direnv",
    ".eggs",
    ".git",
    ".git-rewrite",
    ".hg",
    ".mypy_cache",
    ".nox",
    ".pants.d",
    ".pytype",
    ".ruff_cache",
    ".svn",
    ".tox",
    ".venv",
    "__pypackages__",
    "_build",
    "buck-out",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "node_modules",
    "venv",
    "*.egg-info",
]

[tool.ruff.lint]
preview = true
select = [
    # --- Core rules (existing) ---
    "E",
    "W",     # pycodestyle
    "F",     # pyflakes (unused/undefined)
    "I",     # isort
    "UP",    # pyupgrade (modern syntax)
    "B",     # bugbear (common bugs)
    "A",     # builtins shadowing
    "C4",    # comprehensions
    "PERF",  # performance hints (hot paths)
    "TRY",   # tryceratops (exceptions in async)
    "ASYNC", # async misuse (critical!)
    "RUF",   # ruff-specific
    "PL",    # pylint port (selective)
    "ANN",   # annotations (complements ty)
    "S",     # bandit (security)
    "SIM",   # simplify
    "PTH",   # pathlib over os.path
    "TCH",   # type-checking imports
    "RET",   # return statements
    "ARG",   # unused arguments
    # --- High-value additions ---
    "LOG",  # logging best practices (complements loguru usage)
    "FAST", # FastAPI-specific rules (redundant response_model, missing Annotated)
    "PT",   # pytest best practices
    "T20",  # print statements (catch debug prints)
    "DTZ",  # datetime/timezone (UTC best practices)
    "BLE",  # blind except (prevents catching generic exceptions)
    # --- Medium-value additions ---
    "PIE",  # flake8-pie (various micro-optimizations)
    "ICN",  # import conventions (consistency)
    "FURB", # modern Python patterns & refurb suggestions
    # --- New: blanket suppression + debt tracking ---
    "PGH",  # blanket /type-ignore (PGH003, PGH004)
    "FIX",  # FIXME/XXX/HACK tracking (complements TD)
    "T10",  # debugger left in code (T100)
    # --- High-value for production ---
    "N",   # pep8-naming (class/function/variable naming consistency)
    "SLF", # private member access (enforces encapsulation)
    "EM",  # exception message formatting (best practices)
    "TD",  # TODO/FIXME tracking (technical debt management)
    # --- Additional value-adds ---
    "COM", # trailing comma enforcement (API signatures)
    "FBT", # boolean trap (clarity on bool parameters)
    "G",   # logging format validation (complements LOG)
    "RSE", # exception raising patterns
    "INP", # implicit namespace packages (package structure)
    "PLW", # pylint warnings (for better code quality, e.g., PLW3201 bad-dunder-method)
]

# Enable autofix for safe rules only
fixable = [
    "I",    # isort (import sorting)
    "F401", # unused imports
    "UP",   # pyupgrade (syntax modernization)
    "C4",   # comprehensions
    "SIM",  # simplifications
    "PTH",  # pathlib
    "RUF",  # ruff-specific
    "TC",   # type-checking imports
    # --- New rules with safe fixes ---
    "LOG002",  # Fix invalid logger.getLogger() argument
    "FAST001", # Remove redundant response_model
    "FAST002", # Add missing Annotated
    "T201",    # Remove print() calls
    "PIE790",  # Remove unnecessary pass
    "ICN001",  # Fix import alias conventions
    "PT001",   # Fix pytest.fixture parentheses
    "PT003",   # Remove scope='function' (implied)
    # --- Additional safe fixes ---
    "N803",   # Fix invalid argument names to lowercase
    "N804",   # Fix invalid classmethod first argument to cls
    "N805",   # Fix invalid method first argument to self
    "COM812", # Add missing trailing commas
    "EM101",  # Fix raw string in exception
    "EM102",  # Fix f-string in exception
    "EM103",  # Fix .format() in exception
    "RSE102", # Remove unnecessary parentheses on raise
    "FBT001", # Signal boolean parameter trap (for awareness)
    "PGH004", # Fix blanket  → specific rule codes
    "RUF068", # Fix duplicate entries in __all__
    "PLR6104", # Fix non-augmented assignment to augmented
]
unfixable = [
    "B",   # bugbear (needs review)
    "ANN", # annotations (manual decision)
    "S",   # security (needs review)
]
ignore = [
    "E501",    # line-too-long → formatter handles
    "ANN401",  # Any type (LangChain heavy)
    "ISC001",  # conflicting with formatter
    "TRY003",  # raise from e – sometimes verbose
    "PLR0913", # too-many-arguments (agents/graphs)
    "PLR2004", # magic values (AI logic)
    "PLR0911", # too-many-returns (graph flows)
    "ANN001",  # Missing type annotation (too noisy in AI code)
    "ANN002",  # Missing type annotation for function/method (too noisy in AI code)
    "ANN003",  # Missing type annotation for *args (too noisy in AI code)
    "ANN204",  # Missing type annotation for self (common in FastAPI)
    # --- New rule ignores ---
    "LOG001",  # Direct logger instantiation (loguru is a wrapper)
    "PT011",   # pytest.raises too broad (noisy, covered by tests)
    "FURB101", # Path.read_whole_file (too opinionated)
    "TD002",   # Missing TODO author (noisy for rapid development)
    "TD003",   # Missing TODO issue link (too strict for spikes)
    "FBT001",  # Boolean positional argument (noisy, but caught by rule)
    "FBT002",  # Boolean default value (noisy, but caught by rule)
    "FBT003",  # Boolean positional value in call (noisy)
    "COM812",  # Trailing comma missing (conflicts with formatter in some cases)
    "SLF001",  # Private member access (occasionally needed in tests)
    "RUF029",  # unused-async: FastAPI deps are async by convention
    "PLW0717", # too-many-statements-in-try-clause (orchestration/agent code)
    "PLW3201", # bad-dunder-method: SQLAlchemy declared_attr.directive makes __tablename__ a special pattern
]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-type-checking]
strict = true
# Pydantic builds its validator from these classes' annotations at DEFINITION
# time, so annotations on BaseModel subclasses are runtime code, not types:
# keeping their dependencies in TYPE_CHECKING leaves the field ref unresolved
# (PydanticUserError: class not fully defined).
runtime-evaluated-base-classes = ["pydantic.BaseModel"]
exempt-modules = ["pydantic", "fastapi", "langchain", "langgraph", "docling"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-bugbear]
extend-immutable-calls = ["fastapi.Depends", "fastapi.Query", "pydantic.Field"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["app", "database"]
known-third-party = ["fastapi", "pydantic", "sqlalchemy", "langchain"]
section-order = [
    "future",
    "standard-library",

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"
skip-magic-trailing-comma = false
line-ending = "auto"
# preview = true

# ────────────────────────────────────────
# TY – Type Checker (Astral)
# ────────────────────────────────────────
[tool.ty]
# Inferred from requires-python, but be explicit
[tool.ty.environment]
python-version = "3.12"
root = ["src", "tests"]  # Matches your src layout; tests are type-checked too



[tool.ty.rules]
# --- Runtime error prevention (error level) ---
unresolved-import = "error"
unresolved-reference = "error"
invalid-assignment = "error"

# --- Async correctness (error level, critical for FastAPI + asyncpg/motor) ---
unused-awaitable = "warn"                 # Catch forgotten awaits

# --- Function call safety (error level) ---
invalid-argument-type = "error"
invalid-return-type = "error"
call-non-callable = "error"
missing-argument = "error"
no-matching-overload = "error"
unknown-argument = "error"
too-many-positional-arguments = "error"

# --- Type system integrity (error level) ---
invalid-method-override = "error"  # Liskov Substitution Principle
invalid-exception-caught = "error"
invalid-raise = "error"

# --- Collection/subscription safety (error level) ---
not-iterable = "error"
not-subscriptable = "error"
invalid-key = "error"
missing-typed-dict-key = "error"

# --- Code quality (error level) ---
empty-body = "error" # Catch incomplete implementations

# --- Critical class/function definitions (error level) ---
conflicting-declarations = "error"  # Variable declared as two conflicting types
conflicting-metaclass = "error"     # Metaclass conflicts (runtime error)
duplicate-base = "error"            # Duplicate base classes (runtime error)
invalid-context-manager = "error"   # with statement protocol violations
invalid-parameter-default = "error" # Default values not assignable to param type
dataclass-field-order = "error"     # Required fields before optional fields
invalid-dataclass = "error"         # @dataclass on NamedTuple/TypedDict/Enum/Protocol

# --- Pydantic v2 and magic attribute handling (warn level, allows flexibility) ---
unresolved-attribute = "warn"
redundant-cast = "warn"
unused-ignore-comment = "warn"
unsupported-dynamic-base = "warn"
possibly-missing-attribute = "error"
index-out-of-bounds = "warn"
possibly-missing-import = "error"
unresolved-global = "warn"           # Global variable binding issues
redundant-final-classvar = "warn"    # Final + ClassVar redundancy detection

# --- Optional: Nice-to-have patterns (warn level) ---
deprecated = "warn"                # Track library deprecations
unsupported-operator = "warn"      # Prevent unsupported ops
subclass-of-final-class = "warn"   # If you use @final decorator
ambiguous-protocol-member = "warn" # If you use Protocol
override-of-final-method = "warn"  # If you use @final methods
invalid-explicit-override = "warn" # @override without parent method (PEP 698)

# --- NEW: High-impact rules (error level) ---
missing-override-decorator = "error"      # Require @override on all overrides (catches silent breakage)
missing-type-argument = "error"           # Require explicit type args on generics (list[str] not list)
shadowed-type-variable = "error"          # Prevent PEP 695 type var shadowing in nested generics
invalid-match-pattern = "error"           # Validate match/case patterns at compile time (heavy Result usage)
isinstance-against-protocol = "error"     # Prevent isinstance(x, Protocol) runtime TypeError
isinstance-against-typed-dict = "error"   # Prevent isinstance(x, TypedDict) runtime TypeError
unbound-type-variable = "error"           # Catch type vars used outside generic scope
parameter-already-assigned = "error"      # Catch duplicate keyword args (func(x=1, x=2))
positional-only-parameter-as-kwarg = "error"  # Catch kwarg on positional-only (def f(x, /): f(x=1))

# --- NEW: Medium-impact rules (warn level) ---
mismatched-type-name = "warn"             # TypeVar("U") assigned to T, TypedDict("Film") to Movie
experimental-syntax = "warn"              # Flag A & B, ~A intersections/negations (non-standard)
subclass-of-dataclass-with-order = "warn" # Guard LSP violation with @dataclass(order=True)
useless-overload-body = "warn"            # @overload bodies are dead code
undefined-reveal = "warn"                 # reveal_type() without import

# --- NEW: Guardrail rules (error level, near-zero false positives) ---
cyclic-type-alias-definition = "error"
cyclic-class-definition = "error"
invalid-type-variable-bound = "error"
invalid-type-variable-constraints = "error"
invalid-type-variable-default = "error"
invalid-type-alias-type = "error"
invalid-type-arguments = "error"
invalid-newtype = "error"
invalid-legacy-positional-parameter = "warn"
invalid-legacy-type-variable = "error"
invalid-metaclass = "error"
invalid-named-tuple = "error"
invalid-type-checking-constant = "error"
invalid-type-guard-call = "error"
invalid-type-guard-definition = "error"
non-callable-init-subclass = "error"
override-of-final-variable = "error"
unavailable-implicit-super-arguments = "error"
unsupported-base = "warn"
unsupported-bool-conversion = "error"
static-assert-error = "error"

# --- Additional guardrails (error level) ---
call-abstract-method = "error"
invalid-overload = "error"
invalid-yield = "error"
invalid-typed-dict-field = "error"
invalid-typed-dict-header = "error"
invalid-typed-dict-statement = "error"
abstract-method-in-final-class = "error"
invalid-super-argument = "error"
invalid-paramspec = "error"
invalid-generic-class = "error"
invalid-generic-enum = "error"
invalid-frozen-dataclass-subclass = "error"
duplicate-kw-only = "error"

# --- Quality of life (warn level) ---
ineffective-final = "warn"           # Catch final(type(...)) misuse

[tool.ty.terminal]
output-format = "full"

# Tests deliberately use duck-typed fakes, monkeypatched attributes, and
# pytest.raises(TypeError) probes. Relax type-shape rules there while keeping
# runtime-critical rules (unresolved-import/reference, invalid-return-type,
# await correctness) at full strength.
[[tool.ty.overrides]]
include = ["tests/**"]

[tool.ty.overrides.rules]
invalid-argument-type = "ignore"          # FakeRedis/_FakeApp/dict passed where protocols are declared
unresolved-attribute = "ignore"           # Mock attributes (assert_awaited_once, fake call logs)
missing-argument = "ignore"               # Pydantic Annotated[Field(default=...)] defaults misread as required
not-subscriptable = "ignore"              # object-typed results from fakes
unsupported-operator = "ignore"           # datetime | None comparisons in hypothesis properties
too-many-positional-arguments = "ignore"  # Deliberate TypeError probes on public API
unknown-argument = "ignore"               # Deliberate-typo state keys asserting ValidationError
invalid-method-override = "ignore"        # Test doubles subclassing external bases
missing-override-decorator = "ignore"     # Same test doubles
invalid-assignment = "ignore"             # Monkeypatching module/class attributes
invalid-type-form = "ignore"              # cast("any", ...) escape hatches for redis fakes

[[tool.ty.overrides]]
include = ["src/alembic/**"]

[tool.ty.overrides.rules]
unresolved-import = "ignore"  # alembic.context/op are runtime-provided, not stubbed

[tool.ty.src]

exclude = [

torchvision = { index = "pytorch-cpu" }

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"*" = ["*.txt", "*.md", "*.yml", "*.yaml", "*.json"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "7.0"
addopts = [
    "--strict-markers",

    "--timeout=60",
    "--timeout-method=thread",
    "-m",
    "not integration and not requires_db",
]

pythonpath = [".", "src"]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]

    "unit: marks tests as unit tests",

    "property: marks property-based tests",
]

source = ["src"]
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/test_*",
    "*/__pycache__/*",
    "*/migrations/*",

    "*/.venv/*",

[tool.coverage.report]
fail_under = 50
exclude_lines = [

    "if self.debug:",
    "if settings.DEBUG",
    "raise AssertionError",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if 0:",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "class .*\\bProtocol\\):",

[tool.bandit]
exclude_dirs = ["tests", "migrations"]

[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "app"

# Composition roots — router assembly (app.api), lifespan/graph wiring
# (app.lifecycle), worker composition (app.worker), the database registry and
# seeders — wire features by design and are therefore never source_modules
# below. Their absence from a contract IS the exception.

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Reusable runtime does not import domain implementations"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["app.shared", "app.utils", "app.connections", "app.retrieval", "app.security"]
forbidden_modules = ["app.features"]

    "app.connections.crawl4ai -> app.features.crawler.config",
    "app.connections.crawl4ai -> app.features.crawler.crawler",
    # Pre-existing edge preserved through the 4.1 graph move (clause-episode

forbidden_modules = ["app.features", "app.worker"]

  "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
  "Framework :: FastAPI",
  "Operating System :: OS Independent",
]

dependencies = [
  # Web & app
  "fastapi>=0.141.1",
  "uvicorn[standard]>=0.52.1",
  "jinja2>=3.1.6",
  "python-multipart>=0.0.32",

  # Config & validation
  "pydantic>=2.13.4",
  "pydantic-settings>=2.14.2",
  "jsonschema>=4.26.0",
  "fastjsonschema>=2.22.1",

  # DB & migrations
  "sqlalchemy>=2.0.51",
  "alembic>=1.18.5",
  "aiosqlite>=0.22.1",

  # Utils
  "pyyaml>=6.0.3",
  "httpx>=0.28.1",
  "requests>=2.34.2",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/Goudron/browser-policy-manager"

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
  # testing
  "pytest>=9.1.1",
  "pytest-cov>=7.1.0",
  "pytest-asyncio>=1.4.0",
  "pytest-xdist>=3.8.0",
  "anyio>=4.14.2",
  "beautifulsoup4>=4.15.0",
  # PEP 517 frontend used by the clean sdist/wheel delivery gate.
  "build==1.5.0",
  "selenium>=4.46.0",

  # lint, format & types
  "ruff>=0.16.3",
  "mypy>=2.3.1",
  "import-linter>=2.13,<3",
  "pre-commit==4.6.2",
  # Exact supply-chain tooling keeps audit and SBOM evidence reproducible.
  "pip-audit==2.10.1",
  "cyclonedx-bom==7.3.1",
  "types-PyYAML>=6.0.12.20260724",
  "types-requests>=2.33.0.20260712",

  # local dev
  "ipython>=9.16.1",
]

postgres = [
  "asyncpg>=0.31.0",
  "psycopg[binary]>=3.3.4",
]

ai = [
  "numpy>=2.5.2",
  "onnxruntime>=1.29.0",
  "tokenizers>=0.23.1",
]

[tool.setuptools]
include-package-data = true

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["."]
include = ["app*"]
exclude = ["tests*", "alembic*", "tools*", "scripts*"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
app = [
  "i18n/*.json",
  "presets/*.yaml",
  "static/*.css",
  "static/*.ico",
  "static/*.js",
  "static/profiles_bundles/*",
  "static/vendor/*",
  "static/vendor/vendor/monaco-assets/*.ttf",
  "templates/*.html",
  "templates/profiles/*.html",
]
"app.schemas" = [
  "policies/*.json",
]
"app.compliance.firefox.cis" = [
  "*.yaml",
  "generated/*.json",
]

[tool.ruff]
# Ruff is the single formatter and import-sorter authority.  Keeping a second
# formatter causes alternating output as their preview styles evolve.
line-length = 100
target-version = "py314"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "UP", "B"]
ignore = [
  "E501",  # line length is controlled by Ruff's formatter
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"app/api/*.py" = ["B008"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.14"
warn_unused_configs = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
warn_unused_ignores = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
no_implicit_optional = true
strict_optional = true
pretty = true
exclude = [
  "alembic/versions/.*",
  "dist/.*",
  "build/.*",
]

[tool.importlinter]
root_packages = ["app", "documentation", "tools"]
include_external_packages = false
exclude_type_checking_imports = true

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "delivery depends only downward on the profile backend"
type = "layers"
layers = [
  "app.main",
  "app.api | app.web",
  "app.services",
  "app.compliance",
  "app.models | app.schemas | app.db | app.middleware",
  "app.core",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "owned profile layers have no sibling cycles"
type = "acyclic_siblings"
ancestors = [
  "app.api",
  "app.web",
  "app.services",
  "app.compliance",
  "app.core",
  "app.models",
  "app.schemas",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "schema loader remains a core implementation detail"
type = "protected"
protected_modules = ["app.core.schemas_loader"]
allowed_importers = ["app.core"]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "policy UI registry remains behind the service facade"
type = "protected"
protected_modules = ["app.services.firefox_policy_ui_registry"]
allowed_importers = ["app.services"]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "incubation runtime is only reached through its assembly"
type = "protected"
protected_modules = [
  "app.ai.e5_runtime",
  "app.documentation.local_assistant_runtime",
]
allowed_importers = [
  "app.ai.rag_bootstrap",
  "app.documentation.local_assistant_runtime",
  "documentation.tools.run_assistant_answer_benchmark_0_9_3",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "release assembly cannot reach incubation runtimes"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["app.main"]
forbidden_modules = [
  "app.ai.e5_runtime",
  "app.ai.local_inference_worker",
  "app.ai.rag_bootstrap",
  "app.documentation.local_assistant_runtime",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "release assembly cannot import documentation build tooling"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["app.main", "app.api", "app.web", "app.services"]
forbidden_modules = ["documentation.tools.*"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["requests.*"]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = "-q -m 'not ai_incubation and not live and not browser'"
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["."]
markers = [
  "unit: primary layer — isolated helper or pure-module behavior",
  "integration: primary layer — interaction between application components or adapters",
  "contract: primary layer — stable repository, product, or published-interface contract",
  "browser: primary layer — deterministic real-browser behavior",
  "live: primary layer — external/runtime behavior requiring a provisioned live environment",
  "api: domain — FastAPI/API surface",
  "db: domain — persistence, migrations, or database runtime",
  "schema: domain — policy/schema definitions and validation",
  "ui: domain — templates, static assets, localization, or UI behavior",
  "docs: domain — documentation subsystem",
  "compliance: domain — compliance sources, generation, or validation",
  "ai: domain — optional local-model, inference, retrieval, or RAG behavior",
  "tooling: domain — repository build, developer, or maintenance tooling",
  "slow: duration — intentionally outside the fastest feedback loop",
  "ai_incubation: environment — opt-in AI implementation contour",
  "browser_ui: environment — Chromium/Selenium browser harness",
  "firefox_live: environment — provisioned Firefox enterprise-policy runtime",
  "firefox_live_amo: environment — external Firefox AMO canary",
  "docs_contract: compatibility selector for the docs domain's contract layer; not a primary layer",
  "ui_contract: compatibility selector for the UI domain's contract layer; not a primary layer",
]
filterwarnings = [
  "ignore:websockets\\.legacy is deprecated:DeprecationWarning:websockets\\.legacy",
  "ignore:websockets\\.server\\.WebSocketServerProtocol is deprecated:DeprecationWarning:uvicorn\\.protocols\\.websockets\\.websockets_impl",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
source = ["app"]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
skip_empty = true

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode = "auto"

[tool.mypy]
ignore_missing_imports = true
plugins = ["pydantic.mypy"]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["app"]
omit = ["tests/*", "scripts/*"]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
skip_empty = true

# ── Import Linter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Enforces the unidirectional dependency rules from our architecture.
# Run with: lint-imports

[tool.importlinter]
root_packages = ["app"]

# Rule 1: Core must NEVER import from domains
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Core independence"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["app.core"]
forbidden_modules = ["app.domains"]

# Rule 2: Domains must not import from each other (except via core events)
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No cross-domain imports between file_discovery and file_processing"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "app.domains.file_discovery",
    "app.domains.file_processing",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No cross-domain imports between ingest_monitor and tally_light"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "app.domains.ingest_monitor",
    "app.domains.tally_light",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No cross-domain imports between ingest_monitor and presentation"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "app.domains.ingest_monitor",
    "app.domains.presentation",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No cross-domain imports between tally_light and presentation"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "app.domains.tally_light",
    "app.domains.presentation",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No cross-domain imports between storage and file_discovery"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "app.domains.storage",
    "app.domains.file_discovery",
]
# TYPE_CHECKING-only imports for type hints (not runtime dependencies)
ignore_imports = [
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "No cross-domain imports between audio_recording and other domains"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "app.domains.audio_recording",
    "app.domains.file_discovery",
    "app.domains.file_processing",
    "app.domains.tally_light",
    "app.domains.presentation",
]

# Rule 3: Nothing may import from presentation (it's the outermost layer)
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Presentation is not imported by other domains"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
    "app.domains.file_discovery",
    "app.domains.file_processing",
    "app.domains.ingest_monitor",
    "app.domains.tally_light",
    "app.domains.storage",
    "app.domains.network_mount",
    "app.domains.lifecycle",
    "app.domains.cleanup",
    "app.domains.shared",
    "app.domains.audio_recording",
    "app.domains.system_metrics",
    "app.core",
]
forbidden_modules = ["app.domains.presentation"]

# Rule 4: Layered architecture - domains depend on core, not the other way
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Domains depend on core (not reverse)"
type = "layers"
layers = [
    "app.domains",
    "app.core",
]

# Nexus AI Filesystem
[project]
name = "nexus-ai-fs"
version = "0.10.1"
description = "Nexus = filesystem/context plane."
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.14"
license = {text = "Apache-2.0"}
authors = [
    {name = "Nexus Team", email = "team@nexus.example.com"}
]
maintainers = [
    {name = "Nexus Team", email = "team@nexus.example.com"}
]
keywords = [
    "filesystem",
    "context",
    "ai",
    "agents",
    "storage",
    "distributed",
    "llm",
    "vector-search",
    "content-addressable"
]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 4 - Beta",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: Apache Software License",
    "Operating System :: OS Independent",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
    "Topic :: Software Development :: Libraries :: Python Modules",
    "Topic :: System :: Filesystems",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Artificial Intelligence",
]

dependencies = [
    # CLI (needed for basic CLI stub)
    "click>=8.3.3",
    "rich>=15.0.0",
    "tqdm>=4.67.3", # Progress bars for sync operations
    # Configuration
    "pydantic[email]>=2.13.4",
    "pyyaml>=6.0.3",
    # HTML rendering for surface coverage map (#4161)
    "jinja2>=3.1.0",
    # Schema validation — required by archive verify (Issue #4083)
    # to validate v3 portability bundles against manifest-v3.json
    # before trusting mounts.jsonl checksums. Direct dep so slim
    # wheels still verify correctly.
    "jsonschema>=4.20.0",
    # HTTP client (for remote mode)
    "httpx[http2]>=0.28.1",
    "requests>=2.33.1",
    "tenacity>=9.1.4", # Retry logic with exponential backoff
    # Python 3.14 compatibility - pin transitive deps with wheels
    "aiohttp>=3.13.5",
    "frozenlist>=1.8.0",
    "protobuf>=6.33.6",
    "grpcio>=1.80.0",
    # HTTP server (FastAPI + ASGI)
    "fastapi>=0.136.1",
    "uvicorn>=0.46.0", # ASGI server (base profile; use [server-standard] for full stack)
    # Required by FastAPI's Form(...) — token-exchange (#3818) parses
    # application/x-www-form-urlencoded per RFC 6749 §3.2 / RFC 8693 §2.1.
    # FastAPI raises at route registration time without this; declared
    # directly so we don't depend on `mcp` (current transitive owner).
    "python-multipart>=0.0.27",

    # Database

    "greenlet>=3.5.0", # Required for SQLAlchemy async (run_sync in async context)
    "psycopg2-binary>=2.9.12", # PostgreSQL driver (sync)
    "asyncpg>=0.31.0", # PostgreSQL driver (async)
    "aiosqlite>=0.22.1", # SQLite driver (async)

    "redis>=7.4.0", # Redis/Dragonfly client (async support)
    "nats-py>=2.14.0", # NATS JetStream event bus (Issue #1331)
    # Authentication

    "bcrypt>=5.0.0", # Password hashing for local auth
    "cryptography>=48.0.0", # OAuth token encryption (Fernet) + Ed25519 identity signing
    "PyJWT>=2.12.1", # JWT-VC issuance/verification for agent identity (Issue #1355)
    "pyotp>=2.9.0", # RFC 6238 TOTP for server-side password-vault totp codes
    "itsdangerous>=2.2.0", # Signed, TTL-bounded OAuth state tokens (URLSafeTimedSerializer)
    "tiktoken>=0.12.0", # Token counting for chunking
    "markdown-it-py>=4.2.0", # CommonMark-compliant markdown AST parser (Issue #3718)
    "mdit-py-plugins>=0.6.0", # markdown-it-py plugins: front_matter (Issue #3718)
    # MCP Server (v0.7.0)
    # fastmcp<4 pinned deliberately: 4.0.0 (released 2026-08-31) moved
    # `Tool` + `ToolResult` off `fastmcp.tools.tool` and broke every
    # `from fastmcp.tools.tool import ...` site (nexus/nexus#4731 CI
    # post-merge caught it — the pip resolver picks the newest match
    # each cold install).  Bump the upper bound + migrate imports in a
    # follow-up (search "fastmcp.tools.tool" for the 3+ call sites).
    "fastmcp>=3.2.4,<4.0.0", # Model Context Protocol server

    "blake3>=1.0.8",

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/nexi-lab/nexus"
Documentation = "https://nexi-lab.github.io/nexus/"
Repository = "https://github.com/nexi-lab/nexus"
Issues = "https://github.com/nexi-lab/nexus/issues"

[project.scripts]
nexus = "nexus.cli.main:entrypoint"
nexusd = "nexus.daemon:main"
nexus-extensions-index = "nexus.extensions.index:_cli_entry"

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=82.0.1", "wheel"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"nexus" = ["config/*.yaml"]
"nexus.cli" = ["data/*.yml", "data/*.sql"]
"nexus.backends.connectors.gws" = ["configs/*.yaml"]
"nexus.backends.connectors.github" = ["*.yaml"]
"nexus.bricks.auth.daemon.templates" = ["*.plist.j2", "*.service.j2"]
"nexus.bricks.portability" = ["schemas/*.json"]
"nexus.contracts" = [
    "schemas/common/v1/*.json",
    "schemas/common/v1/*.md",
    "schemas/common/v1/fixtures/valid/*.json",
    "schemas/common/v1/fixtures/invalid/*.json",
    "schemas/common/v1/vendor/nexus-vfs/*.json",
    "schemas/vendor/nexus-vfs.gen/*.json",
]
"nexus.extensions._index" = ["extensions.json"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
minversion = "7.0"
# No per-test timeout: CI runners have variable load; timeouts cause flaky failures
# and mask real issues (slow tests should be profiled and optimized, not killed).
addopts = [
    "-ra",
    "-q",
    "--strict-markers",
    "--strict-config",
    "-n", "auto",                 # Parallel execution (auto-detect CPU cores)
    "--dist", "loadgroup",        # Group tests by xdist_group marker for serial execution
    "--ignore=tests/evaluation",  # Exclude LLM evaluation tests from default runs
    "--ignore=tests/benchmarks",  # Exclude benchmarks from default runs (run via benchmark.yml)
]
# Coverage disabled by default for faster local runs. Enable in CI:
#   pytest --cov=nexus --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=html --cov-report=xml
testpaths = ["tests"]
pythonpath = ["tests"]
asyncio_mode = "auto"
log_cli = false
log_cli_level = "WARNING"
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*"]
filterwarnings = [
    "ignore:Importing .* from nexus\\.services\\..* is deprecated:DeprecationWarning",
]
markers = [
    "slow: marks tests as slow (deselect with '-m \"not slow\"')",
    "integration: marks tests as integration tests",
    "e2e: marks tests as end-to-end tests",
    "benchmark: marks tests as benchmarks",
    "evaluation: marks tests as LLM evaluation tests (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)",
    "quarantine: Tests that are flaky or timing-dependent (deselected by default in CI)",
    "postgres: marks tests that require a running PostgreSQL instance (Issue #1299)",
    "benchmark_ci: critical benchmarks run on every PR",
    "vault: marks tests that require a running Vault dev server (opt-in, see docs/guides/auth-envelope-encryption.md)",
    "kms: marks tests that require a reachable AWS KMS endpoint (opt-in, real AWS or LocalStack)",
    "sandbox_memory: SANDBOX memory benchmark (skipped by default; run with -m sandbox_memory)",
    "demo_memory: nexusd demo profile RSS regression (slow, requires Docker; Issue #3997)",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["src/nexus"]
omit = [
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/test_*.py",
    "*/__pycache__/*",
    "*/site-packages/*",
    "*/cli.py",  # Old location (kept for backward compatibility)
    "src/nexus/cli/*",  # CLI is tested via integration tests in examples/test_cli_commands.sh
]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "def __repr__",
    "raise AssertionError",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "if typing.TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "@abstractmethod",
    "@abc.abstractmethod",
]

[tool.mypy]
# Type checking configuration - Phase 3 will enable full strict mode
python_version = "3.14"
mypy_path = "stubs"
exclude = [
    "_pb2(_grpc)?\\.py$",  # Generated gRPC/protobuf stubs
]
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
disallow_incomplete_defs = true
check_untyped_defs = true
disallow_untyped_decorators = false
no_implicit_optional = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
warn_unused_ignores = true  # Phase 3: Will fix all 531 type: ignore comments
warn_no_return = true
follow_imports = "normal"
ignore_missing_imports = true  # Phase 3: Will remove and add proper stubs
strict_optional = true
strict_equality = true
show_error_codes = true
show_column_numbers = true
pretty = true

# Phase 3 goals (currently have 531 type: ignore comments to eliminate):
# - disallow_any_generics = true
# - disallow_any_unimported = true
# - disallow_subclassing_any = true
# - strict = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = [
    "click.*",
    "rich.*",
    "alembic.*",
    "google.cloud.*",
    "yaml",
]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.storage._metadata_mapper_generated"
# Proto-generated metadata_pb2 resolves to Any without a generated stub
disable_error_code = ["attr-defined"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.backends.gcs"
# Legacy backend - return-type / override mismatches
disable_error_code = ["attr-defined", "override", "return-value"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.backends.gcs_connector"
# Return-type mismatch in connector methods
disable_error_code = ["attr-defined", "return-value"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.backends.transports.gcs_transport"
# google-cloud-storage stubs return Any; attr-defined from google.cloud.storage
disable_error_code = ["attr-defined", "no-any-return"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.backends.transports.s3_transport"
# boto3 stubs return Any for all S3 client methods
disable_error_code = ["no-any-return"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.backends.cas_backend"
# json.loads returns Any
disable_error_code = ["no-any-return"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.tools.langgraph.nexus_tools"
# RemoteServiceProxy dispatches via __getattr__, returning Any
warn_return_any = false
disable_error_code = ["no-any-return"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.bricks.*.tests.*"
# Brick-internal test files (moved from tests/ to src/nexus/bricks/*/tests/).
# Relax strict typing for test code — fixture parameters are injected by pytest
# and don't need type annotations.
disallow_untyped_defs = false
disallow_incomplete_defs = false

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["tests.testkit", "tests.testkit.*"]
# Test helper modules can be followed by mypy when brick-internal tests import
# them from under src/nexus. Keep them out of production strictness.
disallow_untyped_defs = false
disallow_incomplete_defs = false
warn_return_any = false
disable_error_code = ["attr-defined", "func-returns-value", "override", "return-value"]

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = "nexus.backends.delegating"
# DelegatingBackend delegates all Backend methods to _inner via explicit forwarding.
# mypy resolves _inner.method() return types as Any when Backend is imported under
# TYPE_CHECKING (Issue #1449 recursive wrapping).
warn_return_any = false

    "C4",  # flake8-comprehensions
    "UP",  # pyupgrade

# =============================================================================
# Import Linter — Architecture boundary enforcement (Issue #2286)
# Reference: docs/design/NEXUS-LEGO-ARCHITECTURE.md §1.2, §3.3
# =============================================================================

[tool.importlinter]
root_packages = ["nexus"]
# TYPE_CHECKING imports are violations too (strict mode)
include_external_packages = false

# Contract 1: Bricks are independent — zero cross-brick imports
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
id = "brick-independence"
name = "Bricks must not import from each other (LEGO Principle 3)"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "nexus.bricks.access_manifest",
    "nexus.bricks.approvals",
    "nexus.bricks.archive",
    "nexus.bricks.auth",
    "nexus.bricks.catalog",
    "nexus.bricks.context_manifest",
    "nexus.bricks.delegation",
    "nexus.bricks.discovery",
    "nexus.bricks.filesystem",
    "nexus.bricks.governance",
    "nexus.bricks.identity",
    "nexus.bricks.mcp",
    "nexus.bricks.mount",
    "nexus.bricks.parsers",
    "nexus.bricks.pay",
    "nexus.bricks.portability",
    "nexus.bricks.rebac",
    "nexus.bricks.sandbox",
    "nexus.bricks.search",

    "nexus.bricks.share_link",
    "nexus.bricks.snapshot",
    "nexus.bricks.task_manager",
    "nexus.bricks.upload",
    "nexus.bricks.versioning",
    "nexus.bricks.workflows",
]
# Known violations — ratchet baseline. Remove entries as fixes land.
ignore_imports = [
    # (removed: memory -> search, search -> cache embeddings — now use importlib)
    # (removed: nexus.storage -> nexus.cache.protocols — both are non-brick pillar modules now)
    # cache -> rebac transitive chain (via nexus.server.telemetry, Issue #2179)
    "nexus.server.telemetry -> nexus.bricks.rebac.rebac_tracing",
    # mcp -> rebac: TYPE_CHECKING imports for middleware/profiles (Issue #2429)
    "nexus.bricks.mcp.middleware -> nexus.bricks.rebac.manager",
    "nexus.bricks.mcp.profiles -> nexus.bricks.rebac.manager",
    # search -> rebac: permission enforcement + entity registry in search_service (moved from services/)
    "nexus.bricks.search.search_service -> nexus.bricks.rebac.enforcer",
    "nexus.bricks.search.search_service -> nexus.bricks.rebac.manager",
    # parsers -> sandbox: TYPE_CHECKING imports for sandbox provider (Issue #2429)
    "nexus.bricks.parsers.validation.runner -> nexus.bricks.sandbox.sandbox_provider",
    "nexus.bricks.parsers.validation.detector -> nexus.bricks.sandbox.sandbox_provider",
    # portability -> * : export_service imports top-level nexus package (transitive hub, Issue #2436)
    "nexus.bricks.portability.export_service -> nexus",
    # mcp -> nexus: server.py imports top-level nexus package — same transitive hub pattern
    "nexus.bricks.mcp.server -> nexus",
    # Ratchet entries exposed by expanding the module list to all active bricks.
    "nexus.bricks.approvals.grpc_auth -> nexus.bricks.auth.types",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.cli_glue -> nexus.cli.utils",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.cli_glue -> nexus.bricks.portability.export_service",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.cli_glue -> nexus.bricks.portability.import_service",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.cli_glue -> nexus.bricks.portability.models",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.cli_glue -> nexus.bricks.portability.signer",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.cli_glue -> nexus.bricks.portability.trust",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.orchestrator -> nexus.bricks.portability.models",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.tests.unit.test_verify -> nexus.bricks.portability.signer",
    "nexus.bricks.archive.verify -> nexus.bricks.portability.signer",
    # archive.verify -> portability.bundle (Issue #4083): v3 bundles
    # need BundleReader.validate() inside the same tarfile handle as
    # the signature check (TOCTOU-safe). Cross-brick exception lives
    # alongside the existing portability.signer entry above.
    "nexus.bricks.archive.verify -> nexus.bricks.portability.bundle",
    "nexus.bricks.mcp.connection_manager -> nexus.bricks.approvals.policy_gate",
    "nexus.bricks.mcp.mcp_service -> nexus.bricks.approvals.policy_gate",
    "nexus.bricks.mcp.mount -> nexus.bricks.approvals.models",

# Contract 2: Five-tier layered architecture
# contracts (include/linux) < lib+security (lib/) < kernel (core) < services  bricks
# contracts is the type-definition base — everyone can depend on it.
# lib and security provide utilities that may use contract types, like Linux lib/ includes include/linux/.
# security is tier-neutral (TLS, TOFU, prompt sanitizer) — zero kernel/service/brick deps.
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
id = "four-tier-layers"
name = "Five-tier architecture: contracts < lib+security < kernel < services  bricks"
type = "layers"
layers = [
    "nexus.bricks",
    "nexus.services",
    "nexus.core",
    "nexus.lib | nexus.security",
    "nexus.contracts",
]
# Ratchet baseline — known violations. Remove entries as fixes land.
# Run: lint-imports --contract four-tier-layers to check.
ignore_imports = [
    # --- tier-neutral (contracts) importing core ---
    "nexus.contracts.metadata -> nexus.core._compact_generated",
    # --- tier-neutral (contracts/protocols) importing bricks ---
    # chunked_upload protocol TYPE_CHECKING import for UploadSession return type
    "nexus.contracts.protocols.chunked_upload -> nexus.bricks.upload.upload_session",
    # --- contracts importing lib (upward — legacy, to be fixed) ---
    "nexus.contracts -> nexus.lib.validators",
    "nexus.contracts.deployment_profile -> nexus.lib.performance_tuning",
    "nexus.contracts.types -> nexus.storage.read_set",
    # WirableFS TYPE_CHECKING imports (cross-tier wiring contract, #2359)
    "nexus.contracts.wirable_fs -> nexus.storage.record_store",
    # (removed: services.delegation/memory/governance → bricks entries; modules relocated to bricks/)
    # --- bricks importing non-layer modules ---
    # --- non-layer module chain hops ---
    "nexus.factory -> nexus.factory.orchestrator",
    "nexus.factory -> nexus.factory.wallet",
    "nexus.factory.wallet -> nexus.bricks.pay.constants",
    # (removed: nexus.services.sync.sync_service -> glob_fast; now uses importlib)
]
unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = "warn"

# Contract 3: Explicit top-level package boundary coverage.
# This complements the layered contract above, which intentionally models the
# core tier names but does not enumerate every top-level package in src/nexus.
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
id = "top-level-packages-must-not-import-server"
name = "Non-server top-level packages must not import server"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
    "nexus.backends",
    "nexus.contracts",
    "nexus.core",
    "nexus.factory",
    "nexus.fs",
    "nexus.lib",
    "nexus.remote",
    "nexus.security",
    "nexus.services",
    "nexus.storage",
]
forbidden_modules = ["nexus.server"]
allow_indirect_imports = true
# Known lazy direct imports used for optional server-side wiring/debug metadata.
# Remove entries as these dependencies move behind protocols.
ignore_imports = [
    "nexus.factory._system -> nexus.server.observability.observability_subsystem",
    "nexus.remote.rpc_proxy -> nexus.server._rpc_params_generated",
]
unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = "warn"

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pre-commit>=4.6.2",
    "pytest>=8.4.2",
    "pytest-cov>=5.0.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23.0",
    "mypy>=1.11.0",
    "ruff>=0.16.2,<0.17.0",
    "bandit>=1.7.9",
    "mkdocs>=1.6.1",
    "mkdocs-material>=9.6.22",
    "mdformat>=0.7.17",
    "mdformat-gfm>=0.3.5",
    "ipykernel>=7.1.0",
    "pip-audit>=2.9.0",
    "import-linter>=2.0",
    "grimp>=3.5",
]
release = [
    "twine>=6.2.0,<7.0.0",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["setuptools>=61.0"]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

# Mechanical enforcement of the layering rules stated in AGENTS.md. Until now
# those rules were prose that only code review could catch.
[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "createagents"

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Clean Architecture layers point inward"
type = "layers"
containers = ["createagents"]
# Highest first. `main` is the composition root: it wires infra into the use
# cases and launches the CLI. `presentation` sits below it and depends on the
# `AgentFacade` protocol it declares itself, never on the concrete facade --
# that is what keeps the graph acyclic.
layers = ["main", "presentation", "infra", "application", "domain"]

# `utils` is shared by infra and presentation, so it must stay a leaf: an
# import from utils into any layer would make it a back door around the graph.
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "utils is a dependency-free leaf"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["createagents.utils"]
forbidden_modules = [
    "createagents.domain",
    "createagents.application",
    "createagents.infra",
    "createagents.main",
    "createagents.presentation",
]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.12"
mypy_path = ["src", "scripts/quality_gates"]
explicit_package_bases = true
warn_return_any = true
warn_unused_configs = true
disallow_any_unimported = true
disallow_any_generics = true
disallow_subclassing_any = true
# Every definition in `src` is annotated, so mypy checks all bodies instead
# of silently skipping untyped ones.
disallow_untyped_defs = true
disallow_incomplete_defs = true
disallow_untyped_calls = true
disallow_untyped_decorators = true
check_untyped_defs = true
no_implicit_optional = true
no_implicit_reexport = true
strict_equality = true
extra_checks = true
warn_redundant_casts = true
warn_unused_ignores = true

[tool.bandit]
exclude_dirs = [".venv"]

[tool.ruff]
# Blue style: 79 characters line length
line-length = 79
# The internal harness is generated development tooling, not package code.
# Its own verification entry points remain responsible for that boundary.
extend-exclude = [".agents"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
# Pinned explicitly so the result does not drift with Ruff's default ruleset
# between versions. Keep in sync with the ruff rev in .pre-commit-config.yaml.
select = [
    "E", "W", "F",   # pycodestyle + pyflakes
    "I",             # import sorting
    "B",             # bugbear
    "C4",            # comprehensions
    "UP",            # pyupgrade
    "SIM",           # simplify
    "RET",           # return statements
    "G", "LOG",      # logging correctness
    "DTZ",           # timezone-aware datetimes
    "PIE", "PERF",   # misc + performance
    "BLE",           # blind except
    "PYI",           # typing stubs correctness
    "D",             # Google-style docstrings
    "ERA",           # commented-out code
    "TRY",           # exception handling
    "RUF",           # ruff-specific
    "T201",          # flake8-print: disallow print/pprint in library code
    "PGH",           # pygrep-hooks: disallow blanket type: ignore and noqa
    "C901",          # mccabe: cyclomatic complexity
]
ignore = [
    "E501",    # line length is owned by ruff-format
    "D100",    # module docstrings are optional at the package boundary
    "D104",    # package docstrings are optional at the package boundary
    "D107",    # __init__ docstrings are optional
    "TRY003",  # long messages in raise: the project's exceptions are message-driven
    "TRY300",  # try/else restructuring: not worth churning the adapters
    "TRY301",  # raise-within-try is used deliberately in the retry/adapters flow
]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "google"

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# Preserve the previous docstring-gate scope: docstrings are enforced for
# product source, while repository tooling and tests keep their contracts.
"scripts/**/*.py" = ["D"]
"tests/**/*.py" = ["D"]
# The public Message contract intentionally reports invalid roles as ValueError.
"src/createagents/domain/value_objects/message.py" = ["TRY004"]
# These boundaries must isolate failures from third-party tools and callbacks.
"src/createagents/domain/services/tool_executor.py" = ["BLE001"]
"src/createagents/infra/config/retry.py" = ["BLE001"]
# The renderer is the only product module whose explicit terminal output is
# part of its interface.
"src/createagents/presentation/cli/ui/terminal_renderer.py" = ["T201"]
# These entry-point scripts report gate results to their callers via stdout.
"scripts/check-import-cycles.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/check_diff_sanity.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/check_harness_projection.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/check_lockfile_sync.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/check_test_contracts.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/check_test_integrity.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/quality_gate_policy.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/quality_gates/resolve_ci_range.py" = ["T201"]
# Concurrency tests collect all worker failures for assertions after joins.
"tests/domain/value_objects/test_history.py" = ["BLE001"]
"tests/infra/config/test_environment.py" = ["BLE001"]
"tests/infra/config/test_environment_thread_safety.py" = ["BLE001"]
"tests/infra/config/test_metrics.py" = ["BLE001"]
"tests/infra/config/test_sensitive_data_filter.py" = ["BLE001"]

[tool.ruff.format]
# Blue style: Single quotes
quote-style = "single"
indent-style = "space"
skip-magic-trailing-comma = false
line-ending = "auto"

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["stilt"]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
exclude_also = [
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "@(abc\\.)?abstractmethod",
    "def __repr__",
]

[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "stilt"
# An import used only for type hints is not a dependency at run time.
exclude_type_checking_imports = true

# The package in layers, top to bottom: a module may import the layers
# below it, never those above. Modules that import each other share a layer
# (joined by ":"); "|" joins modules that must not. The observation layer
# sits above the transport core, which runs without it; receptors and the
# raster layer import nothing above them; a transport model's package, in
# the transport layer, does not import the project config. Exhaustive, so
# a new module has to be placed. Imports inside functions count.
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "The package's layers"
type = "layers"
containers = ["stilt"]
exhaustive = true
layers = [
    "__main__",
    "cli",
    "observations",
    "project : execution : config",
    "check",
    "simulation",
    "output",
    "footprint : identity : meteorology : transport",
    "particles",
    "receptors : visualization",
    "transforms | sampling",
    "spatial",
    "_paths | exceptions",
]

# HYSPLIT is one transport model, reached through stilt.transport.get_model.
# Its package is the only place that knows HYSPLIT's files and behaviour, so
# a second model would not have to touch the core.
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Only the transport registry imports HYSPLIT's package"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["stilt.*"]
forbidden_modules = ["stilt.transport.hysplit"]
ignore_imports = ["stilt.transport -> stilt.transport.hysplit"]
# get_model imports a model's package when asked for it; that is the boundary.
allow_indirect_imports = true

# Config classes do no I/O when they validate, so a config.yaml loads
# offline. Reading a footprint geometry or asking a transport model its
# build happens on request, in ProjectConfig.resolve. The config never reads
# results or runs anything. It shares a layer with the project and the
# execution package, which import each other, so this is its own contract.
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "The project config reads no results and runs nothing"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["stilt.config"]
forbidden_modules = [
    "stilt.execution.runner",
    "stilt.execution.worker",
    "stilt.output",
    "stilt.project",
    "stilt.simulation",
    "stilt.transport.hysplit",
]
allow_indirect_imports = true

[tool.pyrefly]
project-includes = ["src"]
python-version = "3.11"  # as CI checks, against the oldest supported Python

[tool.pytest]
minversion = "9.0"
testpaths = ["tests"]
strict = true  # strict markers, config, xfail and parametrize ids
addopts = ["-ra"]
log_level = "INFO"  # show captured logs for failing tests
# Warnings are errors, so deprecations surface early. Ignore a specific
# third-party warning with e.g. "ignore:some message:DeprecationWarning:pkg".
filterwarnings = [
    "error",
    # numpy ignores this one itself (compiled packages such as netCDF4 raise it on
    # import); pytest's "error" filter would bring it back.
    "ignore:numpy.ndarray size changed:RuntimeWarning",
]
markers = [
    # Disjoint: a test has at most one of these. `just test` runs none of them;
    # CI runs -m "integration or fidelity", then -m r_only.
    "integration: PYSTILT end to end, with real met files and HYSPLIT (slow)",
    "fidelity: PYSTILT against STILT-R, both running HYSPLIT on real met files (slow; require STILT_R_DIR and Rscript)",
    "r_only: PYSTILT against STILT-R without met files or HYSPLIT (fast; require STILT_R_DIR and Rscript)",
]
env_files = [".env"]

[tool.repo-review]
# Scientific Python repo-review (`uvx --from "sp-repo-review[cli]" sp-repo-review .`)

ignore = [
    "PY007",  # task runner: just, not nox/tox
    "MY101",  # pyrefly's default preset; tighten per project
    "PC110", "PC190",  # ruff runs as a local `uv run` hook, so uv.lock pins its version
    "PC140",  # pyrefly runs as a local `uv run` hook, so it sees the project's dependencies
    "PC160",  # no spell checker
    "PC180",  # no markdown formatter
    "PC901", "PC902", "PC903",  # pre-commit.ci is not used
]

[tool.ruff]
# target-version comes from project.requires-python

[tool.ruff.format]

[tool.ruff.lint]

    "F",  # Pyflakes

    "B",  # flake8-bugbear
    "SIM",  # flake8-simplify
    "I",  # isort

    "D213",  # docstring summary on the second line
    "NPY",  # NumPy-specific, incl. NumPy 2 deprecations
    "RUF100",  # unused noqa
]
ignore = [

    "D105",  # magic methods need no docstring (docstr-coverage skips them too)
    "D200",  # One-line docstring should fit on one line with quotes
    "D212",  # Multi-line docstring summary should start at the first line
    "D400",  # First line should end with a period, question mark, or exclamation point
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# Tests need no docstrings, and a fixture's names what it provides ("A point
# receptor."); the other docstring rules still apply to them.

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]

[project.scripts]

[tool.setuptools.packages.find]
where = ["src"]

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"stilt" = ["py.typed"]

[tool.setuptools_scm]
# Releases are git tags vX.Y.Z (see CONTRIBUTING.md). Between releases the
# version is the next one as a dev version, e.g. 0.1.0a23.dev3+g1a2b3c4.
fallback_version = "0.0.0"  # no git metadata at all (e.g. a bare source copy)

[tool.uv]

cache-keys = [
    { file = "pyproject.toml" },
    { file = "setup.py" },
    { git = { commit = true, tags = true } },
]

# ruff 0.16 widened its default rule set to ~920 rules; pin the bitranox curated policy
# instead of inheriting whatever the default grows to on the next ruff release.
select = [
  "E", "W",     # pycodestyle
  "F",           # pyflakes
  "I",           # isort
  "N",           # pep8-naming
  "UP",          # pyupgrade
  "B",           # bugbear
  "A",           # builtins shadowing
  "C4",          # comprehension simplification
  "C90",         # mccabe: cyclomatic complexity, at most 10 (ruff's default)
  "SIM",         # simplification
  "TCH",         # type-checking imports
  "RUF",         # ruff-specific
  "G",           # logging format (catches f-string in logger)
  "T20",         # print statements
  "PTH",         # pathlib preference
  "PLC", "PLE",  # pylint conventions/errors
  "S",           # flake8-bandit security checks
  "PERF",        # performance anti-patterns
  "ERA",         # eradicate dead/commented-out code
  "FBT",         # boolean trap (boolean positional args)
  "PLR",         # pylint refactor
  "PLW",         # pylint warnings
  "D",           # pydocstyle, Google convention (below); tests and notebooks are exempt
]

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "google"

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-type-checking]
# ConfMail (lib_mail.py) resolves its field annotations at model-build time, so its
# field-type imports must stay at runtime. Telling ruff about the Pydantic base keeps
# TC001/TC002/TC003 from moving those imports into a TYPE_CHECKING block and breaking
# model construction.
runtime-evaluated-base-classes = ["pydantic.BaseModel", "btx_lib_mail.secret_safety.SecretSafeModel"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# ignore the "unused import sys" in the jupyter notebook - which we need (it is a linter hickup)
"notebooks/*.ipynb" = ["F401", "D"]
# Tests: assert is standard, test fixtures have passwords, magic values are clearer inline, temp
# paths are fine. PLC0415: local/deferred imports are a deliberate test idiom - several tests
# import inside the test body to exercise import-time and cache behaviour.
# D: test docstrings narrate a scenario; the Google convention is for the package API.
"tests/*.py" = ["D", "S101", "S105", "S106", "S108", "T20", "PLR2004", "PLR0913", "FBT001", "FBT003", "PLC0415"]
# aiosmtpd dispatches by exact method name (handle_<VERB>, smtp_<VERB> matching the
# uppercase SMTP command), so these e2e test handlers cannot be lowercased.
"tests/test_streaming.py" = ["N802"]
"tests/smtp_test_server.py" = ["N802"]

[tool.pyright]
typeCheckingMode = "strict"
pythonVersion = "3.10"
extraPaths = [
  "src",
]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
addopts = ["--doctest-modules"]
doctest_optionflags = ["ELLIPSIS", "NORMALIZE_WHITESPACE"]
pythonpath = ["src"]
markers = [
  "os_agnostic: test runs on every supported operating system",
  "os_windows: test exercises Windows-only behavior",
  "os_macos: test exercises macOS-only behavior",
  "os_posix: test exercises behavior requiring POSIX semantics",
  "os_linux: test exercises Linux-only behavior",
  "local_only: test requires local environment (e.g., real SMTP via TEST_SMTP_* env vars)",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
parallel = false
data_file = ".coverage.unit"
source = ["src/btx_lib_mail"]

[tool.coverage.report]
omit = [
  "tests/*",
]
fail_under = 85
show_missing = true

[tool.clean]
# Patterns to remove when running `make clean`
patterns = [
  "**/__pycache__",
  ".hypothesis",
  ".import_linter_cache",
  ".pytest_cache",
  ".ruff_cache",
  ".pyright",
  ".mypy_cache",
  ".tox",
  ".nox",
  ".eggs",
  "*.egg-info",
  "build",
  "dist",
  "htmlcov",
  ".coverage",
  "coverage.xml",
  "codecov.sh",
  ".cache",
  "result",
]

[tool.git]
# Default git remote for push/release commands
default-remote = "origin"


[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "btx_lib_mail"

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Layered: cli, lib_mail facade, composition, config and transport, attachments and validation, shared base"
type = "layers"
layers = [
  "btx_lib_mail.cli",
  "btx_lib_mail.lib_mail",
  "btx_lib_mail._compose",
  "btx_lib_mail._config | btx_lib_mail._transport | btx_lib_mail._inline_images",
  "btx_lib_mail._attachments | btx_lib_mail._validation",
  "btx_lib_mail.secret_safety | btx_lib_mail.errors",
  "btx_lib_mail._common | btx_lib_mail._descriptor_path",
  "btx_lib_mail.behaviors",
]

[tool.pip-audit]
# Ignore a vulnerability here only after checking that it fires on this project's
# resolved tree (uv pip compile --extra dev) or its .venv, has no fixed release
# to raise a floor to, and is not reachable; name the package and the reason.
ignore-vulns = []

[tool.bashate]
# bashate style settings for .sh files (E003 excluded: indent handled by shfmt)
max-line-length = 120
ignores = ["E003"]

[tool.uv]
exclude-newer = "7 days"
exclude-newer-package = {lib-cli-exit-tools = false, ruff = "2026-10-15T15:23:19Z"}

# The checkers. `pixi.toml` holds the dependencies and the `check` task that runs them

# beartype checks a Protocol by attribute name alone; mypy is what checks the signatures
[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.14"
files = ["zermelo"]
disallow_untyped_defs = true

# gpjax ships no `py.typed` marker, so mypy reports the import itself as an error
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["gpjax.*", "cmocean.*", "cartopy.*", "xarray.*", "cdsapi.*"]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 140
# ruff 0.16 reformats Python fenced in Markdown
extend-exclude = ["*.md"]

[tool.ruff.format]
skip-magic-trailing-comma = true

# Import sorting only, alphabetical
[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["I"]

# Must agree with `skip-magic-trailing-comma` above, or ruff warns that the two will fight
[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
split-on-trailing-comma = false

[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "zermelo"

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Hierarchy of allowed imports (everything conforms to API set in zermelo.interface)"
type = "layers"
layers = [
    "zermelo.experiments",
    "zermelo.methods | zermelo.problems | zermelo.run",
    "zermelo.interface",
]

# log_cli_level = "INFO"
xfail_strict = true
testpaths = ["napari", "napari_builtins"]


# NOTE: only put things that will never change in here.
# napari deprecation and future warnings should NOT go in here.
# instead... assert the warning with `pytest.warns()` in the relevant test,
# That way we can clean them up when no longer necessary
filterwarnings = [
  "error:::napari", # turn warnings from napari into errors
  "error:::test_.*", # turn warnings in our own tests into errors
  "default:::napari.+vendored.+",  # just print warnings inside vendored modules
  "ignore::DeprecationWarning:shibokensupport",
  "ignore::DeprecationWarning:ipykernel",
  "ignore::DeprecationWarning:tensorstore",
  "ignore:Accessing zmq Socket:DeprecationWarning:jupyter_client",
  "ignore:pythonw executable not found:UserWarning:",
  "ignore:data shape .* exceeds GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE:UserWarning",
  "ignore:For best performance with Dask arrays in napari:UserWarning:",
  "ignore:numpy.ufunc size changed:RuntimeWarning",
  "ignore:Multiscale rendering is only supported in 2D. In 3D, only the lowest resolution scale is displayed",
  "ignore:Alternative shading modes are only available in 3D, defaulting to none",
  "ignore:distutils Version classes are deprecated::",
  "ignore:There is no current event loop:DeprecationWarning:",
  "ignore:(?s).*Pyarrow will become a required dependency of pandas:DeprecationWarning",  # pandas pyarrow (pandas<3.0),
  # TODO: remove once xarray is updated to avoid this warning
  # https://github.com/pydata/xarray/blame/b1f3fea467f9387ed35c221205a70524f4caa18b/pyproject.toml#L333-L334
  # https://github.com/pydata/xarray/pull/8939
  "ignore:__array__ implementation doesn't accept a copy keyword, so passing copy=False failed.",
  "ignore:pkg_resources is deprecated",
  "ignore:Deprecated call to `pkg_resources.declare_namespace"
]
markers = [
    "examples: Test of examples",
    "disable_qthread_start: Disable thread start in this Test",
    "disable_qthread_pool_start: Disable strarting QRunnable using QThreadPool start in this Test",
    "disable_qtimer_start: Disable timer start in this Test",
    "disable_qanimation_start: Disable animation start in this Test",
    "enable_console: Don't mock the IPython console (in QtConsole) in this Test",
]

[tool.mypy]
files = "napari"
# This file triggers an internal mypy error, so exclude collection
# TODO: fix this
exclude = "napari/utils/events/_tests/test_evented_model\\.py"
plugins =  "numpy.typing.mypy_plugin, pydantic.mypy"
ignore_missing_imports = true
hide_error_codes = false
warn_redundant_casts = true
disallow_incomplete_defs = true
disallow_untyped_calls = true
disallow_untyped_defs = true
warn_unused_ignores = true
check_untyped_defs = true
no_implicit_optional = true
disable_error_code = [
  # See discussion at https://github.com/python/mypy/issues/2427;
  # mypy cannot run type checking on method assignment, but we use
  # that in several places, so ignore the error
  'method-assign'
]
# see `$ qtpy mypy-args` and qtpy readme. This will be used by `tox -e mypy`
# to properly infer with PyQt6 installed
always_false=['PYSIDE6', 'PYSIDE2', 'PYQT5']
always_true=['PYQT6']


# gloabl ignore error
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = [
  '*._tests.*',
  '*.experimental.*',
  '*._vendor.*',
  '*.benchmarks.*',
  'napari_builtins.*'
]
ignore_errors = true

[tool.coverage.report]

    "pragma: no cover",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "raise NotImplementedError()",
    "except ImportError:",
    "^ +\\.\\.\\.$",
]

    "*/_vendor/*",

]

[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "napari"
include_external_packages = true

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Forbid import PyQt and PySide"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = "napari"
forbidden_modules = ["PyQt5", "PySide2", "PyQt6", "PySide6"]
ignore_imports = [
    "napari._qt -> PySide2",
    "napari.plugins._npe2 -> napari._qt._qplugins",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Block import from qt module in napari.layers"
type = "layers"
layers = ["napari.qt","napari.layers"]
ignore_imports = [
    "napari.plugins._npe2 -> napari._qt._qplugins",
    # TODO: remove once npe1 deprecated
    "napari._qt.qt_main_window -> napari._qt._qplugins",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]

    "napari.plugins._npe2 -> napari._qt._qplugins",

]

[tool.setuptools]
zip-safe = false
include-package-data = true

    "LICENSE",
]

namespaces = false

[tool.setuptools.package-data]
"*" = [
    "*.pyi",
]
napari_builtins = [
    "builtins.yaml",
]


[tool.setuptools_scm]
write_to = "napari/_version.py"

[tool.check-manifest]
ignore = [
  ".cirrus.yml",
  ".pre-commit-config.yaml",
  "asv.conf.json",
  "codecov.yml",
  "Makefile",
  "napari/_version.py",  # added during build by setuptools_scm
  "tools/minreq.py",
  "tox.ini",
  "napari/_qt/qt_resources/_qt_resources_*.py",
  "*.pyi",  # added by make typestubs
  "binder/*",
  ".env_sample",
  ".devcontainer/*",
  "napari/resources/icons/_themes/*/*.svg"
]

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 79
exclude = [
    ".bzr",
    ".direnv",
    ".eggs",
    ".git",
    ".mypy_cache",
    ".pants.d",
    ".ruff_cache",
    ".svn",
    ".tox",
    ".venv",
    "__pypackages__",
    "_build",
    "buck-out",
    "build",
    "dist",
    "node_modules",
    "venv",
    "*vendored*",
    "*_vendor*",
]

fix = true

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "single"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = [
    "E", "F", "W", #flake8
    "UP", # pyupgrade
    "I", # isort
    "YTT", #flake8-2020
    "TCH", # flake8-type-checing
    "BLE", # flake8-blind-exception
    "B", # flake8-bugbear
    "A", # flake8-builtins
    "C4", # flake8-comprehensions
    "ISC", # flake8-implicit-str-concat
    "G", # flake8-logging-format
    "PIE", # flake8-pie
    "COM", # flake8-commas
    "SIM", # flake8-simplify
    "INP", # flake8-no-pep420
    "PYI", # flake8-pyi
    "Q", # flake8-quotes
    "RSE", # flake8-raise
    "RET", # flake8-return
    "TID",  # flake8-tidy-imports # replace absolutify import
    "TRY", # tryceratops
    "ICN", # flake8-import-conventions
    "RUF", # ruff specyfic rules
    "NPY201", # checks compatibility with numpy version 2.0
    "ASYNC", # flake8-async
    "EXE", # flake8-executable
    "FA", # flake8-future-annotations
    "LOG", # flake8-logging
    "SLOT", # flake8-slots
    "PT", # flake8-pytest-style
    "T20", # flake8-print
]
ignore = [
    "E501", "TCH001", "TCH002", "TCH003",
    "A003", # flake8-builtins - we have class attributes violating these rule
    "COM812", # flake8-commas - we don't like adding comma on single line of arguments
    "COM819", # conflicts with ruff-format
    "SIM117", # flake8-simplify - we some of merged with statements are not looking great with black, reanble after drop python 3.9
    "RET504", # not fixed yet https://github.com/charliermarsh/ruff/issues/2950
    "TRY003", # require implement multiple exception class
    "RUF005", # problem with numpy compatybility, see https://github.com/charliermarsh/ruff/issues/2142#issuecomment-1451038741
    "B028", # need to be fixed
    "PYI015", # it produces bad looking files (@jni opinion)
    "W191", "Q000", "Q001", "Q002", "Q003", "ISC001", # https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/formatter/#conflicting-lint-rules
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]

"tools/validate_strings.py" = ["F401"]
"tools/**" = ["INP001", "T20"]
"examples/**" = ["ICN001", "INP001", "T20"]

keep-runtime-typing = true

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-quotes]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
# These follow standard library warnings filters syntax.  See more here:
# https://docs.python.org/3/library/warnings.html#describing-warning-filters
addopts = ["--maxfail=5",  "--durations=10",  "-ra", "--strict-markers", "--strict-config"]
console_output_style = "count"
minversion = "8"
# log_cli_level = "INFO"
xfail_strict = true
testpaths = ["napari", "napari_builtins"]


# NOTE: only put things that will never change in here.
# napari deprecation and future warnings should NOT go in here.
# instead... assert the warning with `pytest.warns()` in the relevant test,
# That way we can clean them up when no longer necessary
filterwarnings = [
  "error:::napari", # turn warnings from napari into errors
  "error:::test_.*", # turn warnings in our own tests into errors
  "default:::napari.+vendored.+",  # just print warnings inside vendored modules
  "ignore::DeprecationWarning:shibokensupport",
  "ignore::DeprecationWarning:ipykernel",
  "ignore::DeprecationWarning:tensorstore",
  "ignore:Accessing zmq Socket:DeprecationWarning:jupyter_client",
  "ignore:pythonw executable not found:UserWarning:",
  "ignore:data shape .* exceeds GL_MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE:UserWarning",
  "ignore:For best performance with Dask arrays in napari:UserWarning:",
  "ignore:numpy.ufunc size changed:RuntimeWarning",
  "ignore:Multiscale rendering is only supported in 2D. In 3D, only the lowest resolution scale is displayed",
  "ignore:Alternative shading modes are only available in 3D, defaulting to none",
  "ignore:distutils Version classes are deprecated::",
  "ignore:There is no current event loop:DeprecationWarning:",
  "ignore:(?s).*Pyarrow will become a required dependency of pandas:DeprecationWarning",  # pandas pyarrow (pandas<3.0),
  # TODO: remove once xarray is updated to avoid this warning
  # https://github.com/pydata/xarray/blame/b1f3fea467f9387ed35c221205a70524f4caa18b/pyproject.toml#L333-L334
  # https://github.com/pydata/xarray/pull/8939
  "ignore:__array__ implementation doesn't accept a copy keyword, so passing copy=False failed.",
]
markers = [
    "examples: Test of examples",
    "disable_qthread_start: Disable thread start in this Test",
    "disable_qthread_pool_start: Disable strarting QRunnable using QThreadPool start in this Test",
    "disable_qtimer_start: Disable timer start in this Test",
    "disable_qanimation_start: Disable animation start in this Test",
    "enable_console: Don't mock the IPython console (in QtConsole) in this Test",
]

type = "layers"
layers = ["napari.qt","napari.layers"]
ignore_imports = [
    "napari.plugins._npe2 -> napari._qt._qplugins",
    # TODO: remove once npe1 deprecated
    "napari._qt.qt_main_window -> napari._qt._qplugins",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Block import from qt module in napari.components"
type = "layers"
layers = ["napari.qt","napari.components"]
ignore_imports = [
    "napari.plugins._npe2 -> napari._qt._qplugins",
    # TODO: remove once npe1 deprecated
    "napari._qt.qt_main_window -> napari._qt._qplugins",
]

[build-system]
requires = [
  "setuptools >= 69",
  "setuptools_scm[toml]>=8"
]
build-backend = "setuptools.build_meta"

[project]
name = "napari"
description = "n-dimensional array viewer in Python"
authors = [

]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Environment :: X11 Applications :: Qt",
    "Intended Audience :: Education",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: BSD License",
    "Programming Language :: C",
    "Programming Language :: Python",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3 :: Only",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.9",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.10",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Visualization",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Information Analysis",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Bio-Informatics",
    "Topic :: Utilities",
    "Operating System :: Microsoft :: Windows",
    "Operating System :: POSIX",
    "Operating System :: Unix",
    "Operating System :: MacOS",
]
requires-python = ">=3.9"
dependencies = [
    "appdirs>=1.4.4",
    "app-model>=0.2.5,<0.3.0",
    "cachey>=0.2.1",
    "certifi>=2018.1.18",
    "dask[array]>=2021.10.0",
    "imageio>=2.20,!=2.22.1",
    "jsonschema>=3.2.0",
    "lazy_loader>=0.2",
    "magicgui>=0.7.0",
    "napari-console>=0.0.9",
    "napari-plugin-engine>=0.1.9",
    "napari-svg>=0.1.8",
    "npe2>=0.7.4",
    "numpy>=1.22.2,<2",
    "numpydoc>=0.9.2",
    "pandas>=1.3.0",
    "Pillow>=9.0",
    "pint>=0.17",
    "psutil>=5.0",
    "psygnal>=0.5.0",
    "pydantic>=1.9.0",
    "pygments>=2.6.0",
    "PyOpenGL>=3.1.0",
    "PyYAML>=5.1",
    "qtpy>=1.10.0",
    "scikit-image[data]>=0.19.1",
