[project]
name = "legoesm"
version = "1.0.1"
description = "legoESM: A Differentiable Earth System Model in JAX"
readme = "README.md"
license = "MIT"
license-files = ["LICENSE"]
requires-python = ">=3.11"
authors = [
    {name = "Pierre Gentine"},
]
keywords = ["earth-system-model", "jax", "differentiable", "weather", "climate"]
classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Science/Research",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.14",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Atmospheric Science",
]
dependencies = [
    # The substrate, carved into its own installable member (uv workspace).
    # Everything still imports as ``legoesm.<subpkg>`` via the shared PEP-420
    # namespace; this is what lets ``legoesm-atmosphere`` / ``-ocean`` / ... be
    # shipped independently on top of the same core (see FEDERATION.md).  Pinned
    # to the matching minor (single-sourced version; members bump in lock-step)
    # so a non-workspace ``pip install legoesm`` cannot resolve a mismatched core.
    "legoesm-core~=1.0.0",
    # The four Earth-system components, each its own installable member on top of
    # legoesm-core (mutually independent — import-linter contract #2).  The meta
    # ``legoesm`` pulls them all; ``pip install legoesm-ocean`` alone is enough to
    # run the ocean standalone.
    "legoesm-atmosphere~=1.0.0",
    "legoesm-ocean~=1.0.0",
    "legoesm-land~=1.0.0",
    "legoesm-ice~=1.0.0",
    # The orchestration cluster (coupler/driver, ml/training/da, tools): the meta
    # package's own modules (cli, config, dycore_factory) import these,
    # so the meta-member pulls the whole stack.  They are mutually interdependent
    # (a uv-workspace cycle), unlike the four independent components above.
    "legoesm-coupler~=1.0.0",
    "legoesm-ml~=1.0.0",
    "legoesm-tools~=1.0.0",
    "jax>=0.5.3",              # install minimum; tested with 0.8–0.9
    "jaxlib>=0.5.3",           # must match jax
    "equinox>=0.11",
    "optax>=0.2",
    "xarray>=2024.0",
    "zarr>=2.18",
    "matplotlib>=3.9",
    "cartopy>=0.23",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "numpy>=1.26",
    "netCDF4>=1.6",
    "scipy>=1.10",
    "pandas>=2.0",
]

[project.optional-dependencies]
# clm-ml-jax is published on PyPI (https://pypi.org/project/clm-ml-jax/).
# The 0.1.0 release ships the DIFFERENTIABLE canopy capability: its
# `_CanopyFluxesDiagnostics` accepts `grid=`, so the canopy-integrated flux
# diagnostics run on the jax.grad tape (CLMMLCanopyConfig(differentiable=True)).
# `clm_ml_interface` still PROBES this capability at runtime and raises a clear,
# actionable error if an older/local build lacks it (so there is never a silent
# wrong answer); forward-only mode (the default) needs only the base 0.1.0.
# Editable local checkouts (`pip install -e ./clm-ml-jax`) still shadow the
# published wheel for development.
canopy = ["clm-ml-jax>=0.1.0"]
# gcsfs/fsspec included: the ML training lane's DEFAULT ERA5 path is a gs://
# zarr store (load_era5_samples / era5_to_state), so the ml extra must open it
# without also requesting [data] (#817 papercut: the WB runbook env built
# --extras dev only and hit ModuleNotFoundError: gcsfs at first data load).
ml = ["imageio>=2.30", "equinox>=0.11", "optax>=0.2",
      "gcsfs>=2024.2", "fsspec>=2024.2"]
mesh = ["pymetis>=1.2", "scipy>=1.10"]
viz = ["matplotlib>=3.9", "cartopy>=0.23"]
data = [
    "gcsfs>=2024.2",
    "fsspec>=2024.2",
]
# Apple-Silicon local-GPU backend via MLX (PJRT plugin). Select with
# ``JAX_PLATFORMS=mps``.
# float32 ONLY — MLX has no float64, so ``JAX_ENABLE_X64=1`` arrays raise and
# complex128 downcasts to complex64; spectral/x64/conservation-grade and any
# mpi4jax-collective run must stay on ``JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu``. Single MpsDevice:
# no SPMD/MPI multi-device. Good for single-device float32 FV dycore / ML work.
mps = ["jax-mps"]
# Interactive configuration wizard (scripts/experiment/wizard.py, `legoesm wizard`).
wizard = ["questionary>=2.0"]
# Tested jax envelope for MPI is >=0.8,<0.10 (runtime-guarded in
# parallel/reductions.py).  jax 0.10 removed the legacy CustomCallV1 that
# mpi4jax 0.8.x used; mpi4jax 0.9.0 (the FFI rewrite, mpi4jax#289) switched to
# JAX's FFI mechanism and works on jax 0.10+ — so pip resolves the FFI 0.9.x by
# default here.  Do NOT cap jax here: uv resolves one universal lock across all
# extras, so a cap would downgrade the default (non-MPI) workspace install.
# For a working MPI stack install `-r requirements_mpi.txt` (pinned combo).
mpi = [
    "mpi4py>=4.1,<5",
    "mpi4jax>=0.8,<0.10",
]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "pytest-xdist",
    "pytest-timeout",
    "ruff",
    "mypy",
    "pre-commit",
    "import-linter>=2.0",
    # Federation packaging validation (scripts/validate_federation_packaging.py):
    # build the per-member wheels + root-absent install in CI.
    "build>=1.0",
    "hatchling",
]
docs = ["sphinx", "myst-parser", "furo"]
all = [
    "legoesm[ml,mesh,viz,data,dev,docs,wizard]",
]

[project.urls]
Homepage = "https://github.com/climate-federation/legoESM"
Repository = "https://github.com/climate-federation/legoESM"
Issues = "https://github.com/climate-federation/legoESM/issues"

[project.scripts]
legoesm = "legoesm.cli:main"

# NOTE: the "legoesm.sw_barotropics" entry points (the FV3 shallow-water dycore
# providers the ocean barotropic solver resolves by name) are declared by their
# PROVIDER, legoesm-atmosphere, NOT here — so `pip install legoesm-ocean
# legoesm-atmosphere` registers them without the root meta-package.  See
# packages/atmosphere/pyproject.toml.

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/legoesm"]

# The sdist ships only the meta-package source; without this hatch packs the whole
# repository (scripts, tests, docs, data: ~130 MB, over the PyPI upload limit).
[tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist]
only-include = ["src/legoesm", "LICENSE", "README.md"]

# === uv workspace (federation carve) ===
# The repo is a uv workspace; the substrate lives in its own member
# (packages/core, dist name legoesm-core) and the root ``legoesm`` is the
# meta-member that depends on it.  Each member's folder drops the legoesm- prefix
# and has no src/ level (packages/<m>/legoesm/<subpkg>); the root depends on them
# via [tool.uv.sources].  All members ship into the
# one ``legoesm`` PEP-420 namespace, so imports are unchanged.
[tool.uv.workspace]
members = ["packages/*"]

# Every inter-member dependency resolves to the in-tree workspace member (never
# PyPI).  All members must be listed here, or uv would try to fetch e.g.
# legoesm-atmosphere~=1.0.0 from an index that does not publish it yet.
[tool.uv.sources]
legoesm-core = { workspace = true }
legoesm-atmosphere = { workspace = true }
legoesm-ocean = { workspace = true }
legoesm-land = { workspace = true }
legoesm-ice = { workspace = true }
legoesm-coupler = { workspace = true }
legoesm-ml = { workspace = true }
legoesm-tools = { workspace = true }

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"
# Vendored 3rd-party CLM-ML-JAX backend (BSD-3) — not written to legoESM's lint
# conventions; audited upstream, excluded from ruff/audits here.
extend-exclude = ["packages/land/legoesm/land/canopy/clm_ml_backend"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I", "N", "W", "UP"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# FV3-native dycore ports (docs/.../fv3_native campaign): these modules are
# loop-faithful, INDEX-EXACT transcriptions of GFDL_atmos_cubed_sphere Fortran
# (sw_core/tp_core/a2b_edge/fv_grid_*).  The Fortran-metric locals are held in
# UPPER_SNAKE fort views (DXA, DEL6_V, SIN_SG, CSG, ...) to mirror the source
# 1:1 — renaming to snake_case would destroy the line-by-line cross-reference
# to the oracle (the higher-priority faithfulness goal).  `fort`/`fort1` are
# deliberately lower-case (they read as array *views*, not classes).  N803/N806
# = kernel args/vars, N801 = the fort view classes.
"packages/core/legoesm/core/fv3_native_sw_core.py" = ["N803", "N806", "N801"]
"packages/core/legoesm/core/fv3_native_d_sw.py" = ["N803", "N806", "N801"]
"packages/core/legoesm/core/fv3_native_duo_sw_core.py" = ["N803", "N806", "N801"]
"packages/core/legoesm/grids/fv3_native_gridstruct.py" = ["N801", "N803", "N806"]
# geopk / p_grad_c / one_grad_p multilevel port (brick geopk_pgrad): same
# rule — the dummies keep the dyn_core names (CG, akap, ptop, npx, a2b_ord,
# d_ext, ...) so every statement cross-references dyn_core.F90 1:1.
"packages/core/legoesm/core/fv3_native_pgrad.py" = ["N803", "N806", "N801"]
# FV3-native oracle validators/tests: same verbatim-Fortran UPPER_SNAKE
# metric locals (SIN/COS/DXC/RC, ...) mirroring the source 1:1.
"scripts/validate/fv3_native/gen_divduo_oracle.py" = ["N806", "N816"]
"scripts/validate/fv3_native/gen_geopk_pgrad_oracle.py" = ["N806", "N816"]
"tests/grids/test_fv3_native_duo_phase4c.py" = ["N806"]
"tests/grids/test_fv3_native_geopk_pgrad.py" = ["N806"]
"tests/grids/test_fv3_native_pgrad.py" = ["N803", "N806"]
# BENCH (NEMO tests/BENCH port, Irrmann 2022): the tracer/heat variables keep
# the NEMO usrdef_istate.F90 symbol names (T, S, T_ic, S_ic, H_max) so every
# formula cross-references its NEMO source line 1:1 (same rationale as the
# FV3-native ports above).
"packages/ocean/legoesm/ocean/experiments/bench.py" = ["N803", "N806"]
"tests/ocean/unit/test_bench.py" = ["N806", "N802"]
"scripts/run/run_bench.py" = ["N806"]
# Fuller CLUBB port (PORT_CLUBB.md): the closure coefficients, model flags and
# intermediate variables mirror CLUBB's canonical symbol names 1:1 (c_K1,
# iiPDF_type, l_use_C7_Richardson, C2rt, Skw, wpthlp, Lscale, ...) as in
# CLUBB-JAX, parameters_tunable.F90, and the CAM ``clubb_*`` namelist. Renaming
# them to snake_case would destroy the cross-reference to the reference and the
# tuning literature (the higher-priority correctness/faithfulness goal), so the
# pep8-naming mixedCase rules are relaxed ONLY for these files.
# Glob over all CLUBB turbulence modules (clubb.py, clubb_grid.py,
# clubb_config.py, clubb_helpers.py, clubb_pdf.py, clubb_mixing_length.py,
# clubb_moments.py, clubb_saturation.py, ...). Excludes the pre-existing
# clubb_lite.py (already clean) only incidentally — relaxing naming there is
# harmless. N815 covers the config symbol fields; N803/N806 the kernel args/vars.
"packages/atmosphere/legoesm/atmosphere/physics/turbulence/clubb*.py" = ["N802", "N803", "N806", "N815"]
# Column-LES diagnosis/pipeline: physical symbol names (C_K, K_m, Pr_t, N_sq,
# cape_J_kg) + CLAUDE.md-mandated unit suffixes (_K for Kelvin) read clearer than
# snake_case; same rationale as the clubb modules.
"packages/atmosphere/legoesm/atmosphere/dynamics/column_les_diagnosis.py" = ["N803", "N806", "N815"]
"packages/atmosphere/legoesm/atmosphere/dynamics/column_les.py" = ["N803", "N806", "N815"]
# LES-suite case registry (docs/atmosphere/les_suite): case-definition dataclass
# fields and generator args carry CLAUDE.md-mandated unit suffixes on kinematic
# fluxes (surface_theta_flux_K_m_s [K m/s], fluxes_K_m_s) whose Kelvin "K" reads as

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Import-boundary enforcement (the path to independent self-running packages).
# These contracts encode the TARGET layered architecture (master plan D7):
#   core (substrate)  <  {atmosphere, ocean, land, ice}  <  coupler  <  driver
# Each Earth-system component must depend only on `core` (+ truly-shared bricks),
# never on another component or on the coupler/driver — that one-way dependency
# is exactly what lets `pip install legoesm-ocean` run standalone (Stage D carve).
#
# `ignore_imports` is the CURRENT-violation BASELINE: the contracts pass today,
# and every entry removed is a real step toward independence (a ratchet).  The
# goal is an empty ignore list = full component independence, enforced in CI.
# Run: `.venv/bin/lint-imports`
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "legoesm"

# === ROOT INVERSION — the highest-priority independence fix ===
# A handful of low-level / shared modules import UP into atmosphere/ocean
# component dynamics; because `grids.halo_latlon -> parallel.latlon_mpi`, that
# single inversion cascades into nearly every cross-component and core→component
# chain.  Fixing these collapses most of the graph:
#   parallel.latlon_mpi  -> atmosphere.dynamics.primitive_eq_latlon_cgrid, ocean.state
#   ml.channel_packing   -> atmosphere.dynamics.{spectral_pe,spectral_sw}, ocean.state
# (a parallel/ML helper should receive grids/state as ARGS, not import components).
# The remaining direct fixes: move the shared C-grid operators
# (ocean.dynamics.latlon_cgrid_operators) and surface-flux/coupling bricks
# (coupler.{bulk_flux,surface_energy,coupling_fields}) into `core`.

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "core is the shared substrate (imports nothing above it)"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = ["legoesm.core"]
forbidden_modules = [
    "legoesm.atmosphere",
    "legoesm.ocean",
    "legoesm.land",
    "legoesm.ice",
    "legoesm.coupler",
    "legoesm.driver",
    "legoesm.runtime",
    "legoesm.training",
]
# EXACT current-violation baseline (no wildcards): alerting="error" means a
# stale entry (coupling removed) or a missed one (coupling added) BOTH fail, so
# the list can only shrink — a true ratchet toward zero.
unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = "error"
ignore_imports = [
    # core->runtime: intentional FUNCTION-SCOPE deferred imports (CLAUDE.md) to
    # avoid the runtime/__init__ <-> core init cycle — not a real layering break.
    "legoesm.core -> legoesm.runtime.backend",
    "legoesm.core.conservation -> legoesm.runtime.backend",
    "legoesm.core.precision -> legoesm.runtime.backend",
    # core->ocean/atmosphere is only via core->grids.halo_latlon->parallel->
    # component (the root inversion above); baseline the core->grids hop.
    "legoesm.core.operators_latlon -> legoesm.grids.halo_latlon",
    "legoesm.core.operators_latlon_3d -> legoesm.grids.halo_latlon",
    "legoesm.core.operators_fv_latlon -> legoesm.grids.halo_latlon",
    "legoesm.core.operators_fv_latlon_3d -> legoesm.grids.halo_latlon",
]

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Earth-system components are independent of each other"
type = "independence"
modules = [
    "legoesm.atmosphere",
    "legoesm.ocean",
    "legoesm.land",
    "legoesm.ice",
]
unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = "error"
# ZERO-IGNORE: the atmosphere/ocean/land/ice components are now genuinely
# independent of one another.  The shared dycore functions are shared through
# the SUBSTRATE, not component->component imports:
#   * lat-lon C-grid differential operators -> legoesm.grids.operators_latlon_cgrid
#     (Group A: both the atm cgrid dycores and the ocean import them from grids);
#   * the FV3 shallow-water STATE pytrees -> legoesm.core.shallow_water_state
#     (Group B pt1: shared by the atm SW dycore and the ocean barotropic solver);
#   * the FV3 shallow-water DYCORE itself is shared via the foundational
#     legoesm.registry.SW_BAROTROPIC_REGISTRY — the atmosphere registers its
#     "fv3sw"/"fv3edge" builders on import and the ocean barotropic RESOLVES one
#     by name (Group B pt2), so neither component imports the other;
#   * parallel.latlon_mpi re-instantiates the MPI dycore via type(model) from the
#     passed-in instance (Group C), not an atmosphere import.
ignore_imports = []

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
# A standalone component package may use the shared SUBSTRATE that legoesm-core
# bundles (core, runtime, parallel, grids, io, timestepping) — but never the
# orchestration layers ABOVE it: coupler, driver, ml/training/da, or the tools
# (forcing, diagnostics, experiments, visualization).  That one-way dependency is
# what makes `pip install legoesm-ocean` (base, core-only) run standalone.
#
# The ONLY allowed component->above edges are the OPTIONAL heavy features whose
# install path is declared as a per-component extra (legoesm-atmosphere[ml],
# legoesm-ocean[ml], legoesm-ocean[tools]) — the SFNO/U-Cast neural dycores / ML
# physics parameterization (-> legoesm.ml.*) and the Stommel-gyre drift diagnostic
# (-> legoesm.diagnostics).  Those exact edges are baselined below; the BASE
# component import is still core-only (`import legoesm.atmosphere`/`legoesm.ocean`
# pulls no ml/tools — verified).  alerting="error" makes this a ratchet: any NEW
# component->above edge that is not one of these declared-optional ones fails.
name = "Components must not import the orchestration layers above them"
type = "forbidden"
source_modules = [
    "legoesm.atmosphere",
    "legoesm.ocean",
    "legoesm.land",
    "legoesm.ice",
    "legoesm.components",
]
forbidden_modules = [
    "legoesm.coupler",
    "legoesm.driver",
    "legoesm.training",
    "legoesm.ml",
    "legoesm.da",
    "legoesm.forcing",
    "legoesm.diagnostics",
    "legoesm.experiments",
    "legoesm.visualization",
]
unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = "error"
ignore_imports = [
    # OPTIONAL FEATURE: SFNO/U-Cast neural dynamical cores + ML physics
    # parameterization. Declared by the legoesm-atmosphere[ml] / legoesm-ocean[ml]
    # extras (top-level imports; the base component does not pull these modules —
    # both sfno_pe and ucast_pe are lazily re-exported by dynamics/__init__).
    # Paths carry the ``neural`` bucket introduced by a16e1493a (dynamics/ reorg
    # into gcm/les/crm/shared/neural) — the pre-reorg flat paths matched nothing
    # and, with unmatched_ignore_imports_alerting = "error", broke lint-imports.
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_sw -> legoesm.ml.sfno",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_sw -> legoesm.ml.normalization",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_sw -> legoesm.ml.channel_packing",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_pe -> legoesm.ml.sfno",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_pe -> legoesm.ml.normalization",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_pe -> legoesm.ml.channel_packing",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.sfno_pe -> legoesm.ml.conservation",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.ucast_pe -> legoesm.ml.ucast",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.ucast_pe -> legoesm.ml.normalization",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.ucast_pe -> legoesm.ml.channel_packing",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.dynamics.neural.ucast_pe -> legoesm.ml.conservation",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.physics.ml_parameterization -> legoesm.ml.normalization",
    "legoesm.atmosphere.physics.ml_parameterization -> legoesm.ml.physics.io",

    "google-adk",
    "pydantic>=2",
    "litellm>=1.83.3",
    "openai",
    "brainglobe-atlasapi",
    "brainglobe-space",
    "numpy",
    "opencv-python-headless",
    "scipy",
    "Pillow",
    "tifffile",
    # Windowed and pyramid-level TIFF reads (langslice.core.native) go through
    # tifffile's zarr store; a deformation record's arrays are an OME-Zarr
    # store (langslice.core.deformable.ome_warp).
    "zarr>=3",
    "python-dotenv",
    "itk-elastix",
    # The deformable engine (langslice.core.deformable): fireants_syn and the
    # packaged trace_borders fit with FireANTs' SyN on torch (on the GPU when
    # torch sees one). FireANTs 1.5.1 is not on PyPI; its GitHub archive at
    # f8a9cc2 builds without the private submodule a git install trips on.
    # SimpleITK is the one dependency of FireANTs it imports; it also runs N4
    # bias-field correction and denoising of the preprocessed channel
    # (langslice.core.image_prep).
    "torch>=2.3",
    "SimpleITK>=2.2.1",
    "fireants @ https://github.com/rohitrango/FireANTs/archive/f8a9cc259ab9113fc43bd99797000fa8fc34eb59.tar.gz",
    # The job folder's cross-process write lock (langslice.job.lock).
    "filelock>=3.12",
]

[project.scripts]
langslice = "langslice.cli:main"
langslice-job = "langslice.doors.cli.jobcli:main"

]
abba = [

]
mcp = [
    "mcp>=1.24,<2",
]

    "anthropic>=1.13",
    "httpx2",
]
dev = [
    "mcp>=1.24,<2",
    "pytest",
    "pytest-xdist",
    "ruff",
    "basedpyright",
    # The layer contracts below (tests/test_import_layers.py runs them).
    "import-linter>=2.1",

    "jsonschema>=4.18",

    "anthropic>=1.13",

package com.adobe.testing.s3mock

import com.tngtech.archunit.core.importer.ImportOption
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.AnalyzeClasses
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.ArchTest
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.ArchRule
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.syntax.ArchRuleDefinition.noClasses
import com.tngtech.archunit.library.dependencies.SlicesRuleDefinition.slices

@AnalyzeClasses(packages = ["com.adobe.testing.s3mock"], importOptions = [ImportOption.DoNotIncludeTests::class])
class ArchitectureTest {
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Layering rules (Controller → Service → Store; model/dto/util are leaves)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * Stores are the bottom layer. They may depend on model, dto, and util but must not
   * reach up into services or controllers.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val storesMayNotAccessUpperLayers: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("..store..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..controller..")
      .orShould()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..service..")
      .because("stores are the bottom layer and must not depend on controllers or services")

  /**
   * Controllers must delegate to services; they must not call store classes directly.
   * KmsValidationFilter and ControllerConfiguration are intentional exceptions:
   * the filter must validate KMS key IDs before the request reaches the service, and
   * ControllerConfiguration wires the filter's store dependency.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val controllersMayNotAccessStoreDirect: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("..controller..")
      .and()
      .doNotHaveSimpleName("KmsValidationFilter")
      .and()
      .doNotHaveSimpleName("ControllerConfiguration")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..store..")
      .because(
        "controllers must delegate to services, not call store methods directly; " +
          "KmsValidationFilter and ControllerConfiguration are the intentional exceptions",
      )

  /**
   * Services must not depend on controllers (no upward coupling).
   */
  @ArchTest
  val servicesMayNotAccessControllers: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("..service..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..controller..")
      .because("services must not depend on controllers")

  /**
   * The model package is a neutral domain leaf: it holds persistence metadata classes
   * that all layers may read, but it must not depend on the persistence layer (store),
   * the HTTP layer (controller), or the business logic layer (service).
   * model→dto is the intentional one-way edge: model classes store dto-typed fields and
   * [com.adobe.testing.s3mock.s3.model.Mappers] defines extension functions that map model to dto.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val modelIsALeafPackage: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("..model..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..store..")
      .orShould()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..service..")
      .orShould()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..controller..")
      .because("model is a leaf package: it must not depend on store, service, or controller")

  /**
   * Utility classes are a leaf layer shared by all layers above the store.
   * They must not reach into the store (they may depend on model and dto).
   */
  @ArchTest
  val utilMayNotDependOnStore: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("..util..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("..store..")
      .because("util is a leaf package and must not depend on the store layer")

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Bounded-context rules (s3 / vectors / common)
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * `common` is the thin shared root beneath both bounded contexts. It must not depend on
   * either context, or on any layer package - otherwise it would no longer be a leaf that
   * both `s3` and `vectors` can safely depend on.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val commonIsALeafPackage: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("..common..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAnyPackage(
        "..s3..",
        "..vectors..",
      ).because("common is the shared leaf package beneath both bounded contexts")

  /**
   * `s3` and `vectors` are independent bounded contexts (two distinct AWS services, wire
   * formats, and exception models). `vectors` may depend on `common`, but the two contexts
   * must not depend on each other.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val s3MayNotDependOnVectors: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.s3..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.vectors..")
      .because("s3 and vectors are independent bounded contexts; s3 must not depend on vectors")

  @ArchTest
  val vectorsMayNotDependOnS3: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .that()
      .resideInAPackage("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.vectors..")
      .should()
      .accessClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.s3..")
      .because("s3 and vectors are independent bounded contexts; vectors must not depend on s3")

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // Cycle-free package slices
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * No package slice may have a cyclic dependency on another package slice.
   * common, s3, and vectors are each a separate top-level slice.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val packagesMustBeFreeOfCycles: ArchRule =
    slices()
      .matching("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.(*)..")
      .should()
      .beFreeOfCycles()

  /**
   * Within the `s3` bounded context, each layer package (controller, service, store, model,
   * dto, util) is its own slice and must be free of cycles.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val s3PackagesMustBeFreeOfCycles: ArchRule =
    slices()
      .matching("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.s3.(*)..")
      .should()
      .beFreeOfCycles()

  /**
   * Within the `vectors` bounded context, each layer package (controller, service, store, dto)
   * is its own slice and must be free of cycles.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val vectorsPackagesMustBeFreeOfCycles: ArchRule =
    slices()
      .matching("com.adobe.testing.s3mock.vectors.(*)..")
      .should()
      .beFreeOfCycles()

  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  // API / annotation rules
  // -----------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * All Jackson XML annotations must use the tools.jackson packages (Jackson 3), not the
   * legacy com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.xml.annotation package.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val noLegacyJacksonXmlAnnotations: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .should()
      .dependOnClassesThat()
      .resideInAPackage("com.fasterxml.jackson.dataformat.xml.annotation..")
      .because("use tools.jackson annotations, not the legacy com.fasterxml packages")
}

package com.adobe.testing.s3mock

import com.tngtech.archunit.core.importer.ImportOption
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.AnalyzeClasses
import com.tngtech.archunit.junit.ArchTest
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.ArchRule
import com.tngtech.archunit.lang.syntax.ArchRuleDefinition.noClasses

/**
 * Architecture rules that apply to the test sources themselves.
 *
 * Kept separate from [ArchitectureTest] because that class analyses production code only
 * (`DoNotIncludeTests`), whereas these rules must analyse the test classes
 * (`OnlyIncludeTests`).
 */
@AnalyzeClasses(packages = ["com.adobe.testing.s3mock"], importOptions = [ImportOption.OnlyIncludeTests::class])
class TestArchitectureTest {
  /**
   * Spring-managed components (services, stores, controllers, filters, `@ControllerAdvice`) must be
   * tested with the Spring test harness — `@SpringBootTest` / `@WebMvcTest` plus `@MockitoBean` —
   * extending the matching base class (`ServiceTestBase`, `StoreTestBase`, `BaseControllerTest`).
   *
   * Standard Mockito unit-test style (`@ExtendWith(MockitoExtension)` + `@Mock` + `@InjectMocks`)
   * bypasses the Spring context and the project's bean wiring, so it is banned. Collaborator stubbing
   * still uses mockito-kotlin (`mock()` / `whenever(...)`), which does not rely on these annotations.
   */
  @ArchTest
  val noStandardMockitoUnitTests: ArchRule =
    noClasses()
      .should()
      .dependOnClassesThat()
      .haveFullyQualifiedName("org.mockito.junit.jupiter.MockitoExtension")
      .orShould()
      .dependOnClassesThat()
      .haveFullyQualifiedName("org.mockito.Mock")
      .orShould()
      .dependOnClassesThat()
      .haveFullyQualifiedName("org.mockito.InjectMocks")
      .because(
        "Spring-managed components must be tested with @SpringBootTest/@WebMvcTest + @MockitoBean " +
          "(extending ServiceTestBase/StoreTestBase/BaseControllerTest), not standard Mockito " +
          "unit tests using @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension) + @Mock + @InjectMocks",
      )
}

[project]
name = "feelies"
version = "0.1.0"
description = "Deterministic intraday trading platform"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "numpy>=2.0",
    "pyyaml>=6.0",
    "tzdata>=2026.3; sys_platform == 'win32'",
]

[project.scripts]
# Operator command-line surface (Workstream F-3).
#
# `feelies promote ...` reads the append-only JSONL promotion-evidence
# ledger written by `AlphaLifecycle` (see
# src/feelies/alpha/promotion_ledger.py) and is read-only / forensic-only;
# it never imports orchestrator or risk-engine production code, so
# operator invocation cannot perturb replay determinism (audit A-DET-02).
# `python -m feelies <subcommand>` resolves to the same dispatcher via
# `feelies.cli.__main__`.
feelies = "feelies.cli.main:main"

[project.optional-dependencies]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0",
    "pytest-cov>=6.0",
    "hypothesis>=6.0",
    "mypy>=1.8",
    "ruff>=0.3",
    "types-PyYAML>=6.0",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0",
    "import-linter>=2.3",
]
massive = [
    "websockets>=13.0",
    "massive>=2.3",
]
portfolio = [
    # Phase-4 PORTFOLIO layer optional dependencies.  Loaded lazily inside
    # composition modules; the pure-Python fallbacks (numpy z-scoring +
    # heuristic turnover optimizer) keep the platform installable without
    # this extra and are the only path exercised under the deterministic
    # parity tests.  Install with `pip install feelies[portfolio]` to
    # enable cvxpy-backed turnover optimization and parquet-backed factor
    # loadings.
    "cvxpy>=1.5",
    "ecos>=2.0",
    "pyarrow>=15.0",
]
ib = [
    # OperatingMode.PAPER + LIVE: Interactive Brokers Gateway adapter.
    # ``ibapi`` is not published on PyPI in the form we need; the
    # community-maintained ``nautilus-ibapi`` mirror provides the same
    # ``ibapi.*`` module tree.  ``protobuf`` is a transitive runtime
    # dep of recent ``ibapi`` releases.  Install with
    # ``pip install feelies[ib,massive]`` to get the full PAPER-mode
    # tool-chain (the WS feed lives under ``massive``).
    "nautilus-ibapi>=10.19",
    "protobuf>=4.25",
]

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

# OneDrive/Windows: hardlinks from the uv cache into .venv often fail
# (EXDEV / "Failed to hardlink files"). Copy instead of warning on every run.
[tool.uv]
link-mode = "copy"

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/feelies"]

[tool.mypy]
strict = true
python_version = "3.12"

# Acceptance Sweep — §18.3 #3 strict-mode scope (docs/acceptance/v02_v03_matrix.md).
#
# `strict = true` is the platform default and applies to **every**
# module under `src/feelies/` — there are **no** per-module
# `ignore_errors = true` overrides.  Workstream gap-Z (closed alongside
# the v0.3 acceptance sweep follow-ups) eliminated the historical
# 8-module override block by tightening the legacy modules in place;
# the surviving acceptance test
# (`tests/acceptance/test_mypy_strict_scope.py`) runs `mypy` against
# `src/feelies` AND parses this file to assert that no future
# `ignore_errors = true` block re-enters the project for any
# `feelies.*` module without an explicit matrix amendment.

[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module = ["cvxpy", "cvxpy.*", "numpy", "numpy.*", "pyarrow", "pyarrow.*"]
ignore_missing_imports = true

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
line-length = 99

[tool.ruff.lint]
# Inv-10 (clock abstraction) — every wall-clock read must go through
# ``feelies.core.clock.MonotonicClock``.  The platform forbids raw
# ``datetime.now()`` / ``datetime.utcnow()`` / ``time.time*`` in the
# production source tree and only allows them in the canonical clock
# adapter and explicitly exempted modules listed below.
#
# The Phase-4-finalize slice extends this ban to cover the new
# composition / monitoring / forensics / risk modules added in
# Phase 4 + Phase 4.1: PORTFOLIO ranker, hazard exit controller,
# horizon metrics collector, multi-horizon attribution, etc.  Any
# such module that needs a current timestamp MUST inject a
# ``MonotonicClock`` (or accept ``ts_ns`` as an explicit parameter)
# so that deterministic replay (Inv-5) and the dual-mode parity
# contract (Inv-9) are preserved.
select = [
    "DTZ",  # flake8-datetimez (DTZ005/DTZ006/DTZ011/...)
    "F401",  # unused-import
    "F841",  # unused-variable
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
# Only the canonical clock adapter is allowed to call wall-clock APIs
# in production source.  Any new module added under ``src/feelies/``
# MUST inherit this ban — do not add per-file-ignores here without a
# written justification anchored to the design doc.
"src/feelies/core/clock.py" = ["DTZ005", "DTZ006", "DTZ011"]
# Ingestion functional tests talk to real wall-clock services
# (Massive WebSocket; throttle pacing) and are explicitly excluded
# from deterministic replay.
"tests/ingestion/test_massive_functional.py" = ["DTZ005", "DTZ006", "DTZ011"]
"tests/ingestion/test_parallel_ingest_integration.py" = ["DTZ005", "DTZ006", "DTZ011"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
markers = [
    "functional: network-backed tests against live external services",
    "backtest_validation: full backtest pipe validation suite",
    "slow: performance benchmarks and long-running tests",
    "paper_rth: requires US RTH + IB Gateway paper @ 4002 + MASSIVE_API_KEY",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["feelies"]
branch = true

[tool.coverage.report]
fail_under = 80
show_missing = true
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
    "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
    "\\.\\.\\.",
]

[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "feelies"

[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
id = "tiers"
name = "Five import tiers"
type = "layers"
containers = ["feelies"]
layers = [
    "cli",
    "bootstrap",
    "ingestion : storage : sensors : features : services : signals : alpha : promotion : composition : portfolio : risk : execution : broker : monitoring : harness : research : forensics",
    "kernel : bus",
    "core",
]

# =============================================================================
# pyproject.toml — OrangeCashMachine
#
# SSOT de configuración del proyecto Python:
#   • build system
#   • metadata
#   • dependencias (agrupadas por bounded context / responsabilidad)
#   • herramientas de desarrollo
#
# La arquitectura del sistema (capas, contratos de import-linter, bounded
# contexts) vive en architecture/. Este archivo NO decide arquitectura,
# solo declara qué se instala y con qué versión — Single Source of Truth
# de dependencias, nada más.
# =============================================================================

[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.16.0"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

# =============================================================================
# Metadata del proyecto
# =============================================================================

[project]
name            = "orangecashmachine"
version         = "0.3.0"
description     = "Pipeline profesional de ingestión, procesamiento y almacenamiento de datos de mercado cripto — arquitectura medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), data lakehouse Iceberg/DuckDB, observabilidad Prometheus"
readme          = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11,<3.14"
authors         = [{ name = "orangemusic" }]
license         = "MIT"  # PEP 639 (SPDX string) — reemplaza la forma tabular {text = "MIT"}, deprecada por hatchling

keywords = [
    "trading", "algorithmic-trading", "market-data", "crypto",
    "data-pipeline", "data-lakehouse", "iceberg",
    "ccxt", "ohlcv", "quant",
]

classifiers = [
    "Development Status :: 3 - Alpha",
    "Intended Audience :: Developers",
    "Intended Audience :: Financial and Insurance Industry",
    "License :: OSI Approved :: MIT License",  # faltaba: debe coincidir con project.license
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.11",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.12",
    "Programming Language :: Python :: 3.13",
    "Topic :: Office/Business :: Financial :: Investment",
    "Topic :: Scientific/Engineering :: Information Analysis",
    "Typing :: Typed",
]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Dependencias — agrupadas por bounded context (DDD) para orden lógico y
# legibilidad. El pin explícito con comentario es obligatorio cuando la
# versión está acotada por una razón técnica concreta (evita "pin mágico").
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
dependencies = [
    # ── Config & validación (bounded context: configuración) ────────────────
    # pydantic: pinneado en 2.8.2 — 2.9 introdujo breaking changes en
    # model_rebuild() con forward refs en schemas anidados (Hydra + Pydantic).
    # ACCIÓN PENDIENTE (prioridad alta): probar pydantic>=2.9 contra
    # ocm/config/schema.py en staging completo. pydantic-settings>=2.13.1
    # puede requerir pydantic>=2.9 internamente — correr
    # `uv lock --dry-run` ANTES de tocar cualquiera de las dos versiones,
    # como single source of truth de resolución de dependencias.
    "pydantic==2.14.0",
    "pydantic-settings>=2.13.1,<3.0",
    # pyyaml: pinneado en 6.0.2 — Hydra 1.3.x requiere exactamente esta API
    # de yaml.safe_load con soporte de anchors. 6.1 cambió el comportamiento
    # de merge keys (<<) que se usan en config/. Desbloquear con Hydra 2.x.
    "pyyaml==6.0.3",
    "python-dotenv>=1.0,<3.0",
    "hydra-core>=1.3.2,<2.0",
    # ── Validación / calidad de datos ───────────────────────────────────────
    # pandera: schema-level validation nativo en Polars
    "pandera>=0.20.0",
    # ── Núcleo de datos (dataframes / arrays) ───────────────────────────────
    # Polars es el único motor DataFrame — migración pandas completada.
    "numpy>=2.0,<3.0",
    "polars[rtcompat]>=1.40.1",
    "pyarrow>=17.0,<27.0",
    # ── Market data / exchange adapters (bounded context: market_data) ─────
    # ccxt: pinneado en 4.3.58 — versiones posteriores cambian la firma de
    # fetch_ohlcv() y el campo default_type en exchange params (CCXTAdapter).
    # Actualizar solo tras smoke test completo contra Bybit + KuCoin en staging.
    "ccxt>=4.5.74",
    "cryptofeed>=2.4.1",
    # ── Resiliencia (circuit breakers: async + fallback sync) ──────────────
    # aioresilience: pinneado en 0.2.1 — API de CircuitBreaker no estabilizada.
    # Versiones posteriores cambian el constructor y los hooks de estado.
    # Acoplado a import-linter CI (aioresilience rompe resolución en Python 3.12
    # con deps transitivas de anyio — ver MIGRATION.md §circuit-breaker).
    "aioresilience==0.2.1",
    "aiometer>=0.10.0",
    # pybreaker: pinneado en 1.4.1 — usado deliberadamente como fallback SYNC
    # de circuit breaker (no es redundancia: aioresilience cubre el path
    # async, pybreaker el sync). 2.x cambia la interfaz de listeners.
    # Sincronizar el pin con aioresilience al actualizar cualquiera de las dos.
    "pybreaker==1.4.1",
    # ── Mensajería / streaming ───────────────────────────────────────────────
    "redis>=7.4.0,<9.0",  # techo <8.0 deliberado: 8.0 cambia RESP2→RESP3 por defecto (breaking)
    "aiokafka>=0.11.0,<1.0",
    # ── Storage / data lakehouse ─────────────────────────────────────────────
    # pyiceberg: <1.0 — API pública no estabilizada en 1.x todavía.
    # >=0.9.1: requiere TimestampType microsecond epoch (int) en scan filters.
    # Actualizar solo tras smoke test completo en staging (iceberg_storage tests).
    "pyiceberg[pyarrow,sql-sqlite]>=0.9.1,<1.0",
    "duckdb>=1.5.1,<2.0",
    "lz4>=4.4.5",
    # ── Web / API layer ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    "fastapi>=0.111.0,<1.0",
    # uvicorn: techo previo <0.29.0 quedó obsoleto (release real vigente:
    # 0.5x.x). Un techo tan viejo bloquea parches de seguridad sin ninguna
    # razón documentada — corregido a un rango abierto razonable.
    # Validar en staging antes de fijar un techo definitivo si se necesita uno.
    "uvicorn[standard]>=0.30.0,<1.0",
    "pyjwt[crypto]>=2.8.0,<3.0",
    # ── Observabilidad (logging + métricas) ─────────────────────────────────
    # loguru: pinneado en 0.7.2 — API de sink Loki acoplada a esta versión.
    # Structlog también depende del record format de loguru. Actualizar con ambos.
    "loguru==0.7.3",
    "structlog>=24.1.0,<27.0",
    "httpx>=0.27.0,<1.0",
    "prometheus-client>=0.20.0,<1.0",
    # opentelemetry: B-17/H-18 — SDK + exporter OTLP HTTP. Pin>=1.28: API
    # estable del tracer provider y propagadores W3C tracecontext. Sin techo
    # <2.0 (compat backward). Resuelto en 1.44.0.
    "opentelemetry-api>=1.28.0,<2.0",
    "opentelemetry-sdk>=1.28.0,<2.0",
    "opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.28.0,<2.0",
]

[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.com/orangemusic/orangecashmachine"

[project.optional-dependencies]
docs = [
    "sphinx>=7.0,<10.0",
    "sphinx-autodoc-typehints>=1.22,<4.0",
]
# ci: sin entradas propias por ahora — pre-commit vive en dependency-groups.dev
# (evita duplicación de SSOT entre optional-dependencies y dependency-groups).

# =============================================================================
# Dependency groups (herramientas de desarrollo, no van al wheel)
# =============================================================================

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8.0,<10.0",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.23,<2.0",
    "pytest-cov>=5.0,<8.0",
    "mypy>=1.9,<3.0",
    "ruff>=0.4,<1.0",
    "import-linter>=2.1,<3.0",
    "bandit>=1.9.4",
    "pip-audit>=2.7,<3.0",
    "pre-commit>=3.8.0",
    "pydeps>=3.0.6",
    # types-pyyaml: versión con sufijo de fecha (esquema típico de typeshed,
    # X.Y.Z.YYYYMMDD) — verificada como release real y vigente en PyPI.
    "types-pyyaml>=6.0.12.20260518",
    # structlog y httpx NO van acá: ya están en [project.dependencies] (arriba).
    # Duplicarlas rompería SSOT de versiones. Si dev necesita una versión más

    "pytest-random-order>=1.2.0",

# =============================================================================
# project.scripts
# =============================================================================

[project.scripts]

# =============================================================================
# tool.uv — override de resolución (ADR-0053)
# =============================================================================
# CVE-2026-104874 (multidict 6.7.1, DoS GHSA-54p9-h82j-f925): fix real vía
# override absoluto multidict==6.9.1, alineado con ccxt/ccxt#30764 (mergeado
# 2026-10-07). El pin exacto multidict==6.7.1 de ccxt queda sobreescrito en la
# resolución. Sin --ignore-vuln, sin risk-accept. NO se toca ccxt. Retirar el
# override cuando ccxt 4.5.86+ publique el pin upstream (tarea de monitoreo).
# =============================================================================

[tool.uv]
override-dependencies = ["multidict==6.9.1"]

# =============================================================================
# tool.ruff
# =============================================================================

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 120
# py311: piso real de requires-python. No usar py313 acá o ruff sugiere
# sintaxis que rompe en 3.11/3.12, que seguís soportando.
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.format]
quote-style = "double"
indent-style = "space"

[tool.ruff.lint]
# E402 — module level import not at top of file.
# Solo se permite en composition roots y entrypoints conocidos (bootstrap,
# lazy imports por orden de arranque). NO se ignora globalmente para no
# enmascarar imports mal ubicados en el resto del código (fail-fast en
# lint por default, fail-soft solo donde el propio diseño lo exige).
select = ["E", "F", "I", "C901", "PLR", "SIM"]
ignore = [
    "PLR2004",  # magic-value-comparison — 166 violaciones; baseline conocida
    "PLR0913",  # too-many-arguments — 75 violaciones; baseline conocida
    "PLR0912",  # too-many-branches — 8 violaciones; baseline conocida
    "PLR0911",  # too-many-return-statements — 7 violaciones; baseline conocida
    "PLR0915",  # too-many-statements — 7 violaciones; baseline conocida
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]

# Lazy imports son intencionales: evitan circular imports en bootstrap order.
# Paths relativos al repo root (donde está pyproject.toml).
"packages/market_data/application/pipelines/ohlcv_pipeline.py"      = ["E402", "C901"]
"ocm/config/hydra_loader.py"                                         = ["E402"]
"ocm/config/loader/env_resolver.py"                                  = ["E402"]

# =============================================================================
# tool.pytest
# =============================================================================

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
asyncio_mode  = "auto"
testpaths     = ["tests"]
pythonpath    = [".", "apps"]
log_cli       = true
log_cli_level = "DEBUG"
addopts       = "--cov=packages --cov=ocm --cov=shared --cov=apps --cov-report=term-missing"
markers = [
    "integration: tests de integración contra infraestructura real (Kafka, Redis, Iceberg)",
]

# =============================================================================
# tool.coverage
# =============================================================================

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["packages", "ocm", "shared", "apps"]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
# Baseline medida en F2.1 (B-06/R5): `pytest --cov=packages --cov=ocm
# --cov=shared --cov=apps --cov-report=term` dio 44% real. Per plan (B-06):
# fijar fail_under un par de puntos por debajo del real (margen) y subirlo
# gradualmente en PRs siguientes — no de un salto a 60.
# *_COVERAGE.activada_en_ci=true en tracking.yaml (R5).
fail_under = 50

# =============================================================================
# tool.bandit
# =============================================================================
# Gate de seguridad R6 (B-07/F2.1): workflows corren `bandit -r <dirs> -ll`.
# Excluimos tests y venv; nivel de severidad mínimo HIGH (-ll) para que el CI
# solo falle ante hallazgos BLOCKER reales, no ruido de severidad media.
[tool.bandit]
exclude_dirs = ["tests", ".venv", ".git", "__pycache__"]
skips = ["B101"]  # assert_used: asserts válidos en guard checks controlados

# =============================================================================
# tool.mypy
# =============================================================================

[tool.mypy]
python_version         = "3.11"
strict                 = true
ignore_missing_imports = true
exclude                 = ["tests/", ".venv/"]
mypy_path               = "packages"
plugins                 = ["pydantic.mypy"]

# pyiceberg no incluye py.typed ni stubs oficiales.
# ignore_missing_imports = true (global) ya suprime ImportMissingStubs,
# pero ignore_errors = true acá previene errores de tipo transitivos
# que pyiceberg puede filtrar hacia nuestro código cuando mypy sigue
# los imports a través de sus módulos internos.
# ⚠️ VERIFICAR: esta sección fue reconstruida por inferencia sobre el
# comentario original — confirmar contra el pyproject.toml real del
# repo antes de aplicar en CI (no asumir que coincide byte a byte).
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
module        = ["pyiceberg.*"]
ignore_errors = true

# =============================================================================
# tool.hatch — build
# =============================================================================

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = [
    "packages/market_data",
    "packages/trading",
    "packages/portfolio",
    "ocm",
    "apps/api",
    "apps/app",
    "apps/research",
    "shared",                   # sin remapping — se instala desde la raíz
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel.sources]
"packages/market_data"   = "market_data"
"packages/trading"       = "trading"
"packages/portfolio"     = "portfolio"
"apps/api"               = "api"
"apps/app"               = "app"
"apps/research"          = "research"
# ocm y shared: SIN entrada intencional. El basename del directorio fuente
# ya coincide con el nombre de import deseado ("ocm" -> ocm, raíz -> shared),
# por lo que hatchling los instala correctamente sin remapeo. Agregar un
# mapeo identidad (p. ej. "ocm" = "ocm") sería ruido sin efecto funcional —
# si aparece un error de instalación real, documentarlo acá con el caso

# architecture/ declara QUÉ PUEDE DEPENDER DE QUÉ (bounded contexts, DIP
# entre capas). Mezclar ambas cosas en un solo archivo violaría SSOT.
# Invocación: uv run python -c "from importlinter.cli import lint_imports; exit(lint_imports(config_filename='architecture_linter/importlinter.toml'))"
# =============================================================================

[tool.ruff]

  "notebooks", # Legacy research notebooks are preserved as evidence, not maintained Python.
  "docs/references", # Upstream reference snapshots retain their original code snippets.
]
force-exclude = true
line-length = 100
required-version = "==0.16.2"
src = ["src", "tests", "scripts"]
target-version = "py311"

[tool.ruff.lint]
ignore = [
  "D105", # Magic methods are documented through their public class contract.
  "D107", # Constructor behavior is documented on the class.
]
select = [
  "A001",
  "A002",
  "ARG",
  "ASYNC",
  "B",
  "BLE",
  "C4",
  "C90",
  "D",
  "DTZ",
  "E4",
  "E7",
  "E9",
  "ERA",
  "F",
  "FBT",
  "G",
  "I",
  "ICN",
  "LOG",
  "N",
  "PERF",
  "PIE",
  "PLR2004",
  "PT",
  "PTH",
  "RET",
  "RSE",
  "RUF",
  "S",
  "SIM",
  "T10",
  "T20",
  "TID",
  "UP",
]

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
# Ratchet toward 10. Flat Pydantic invariant validators are the main reason not to start there.
max-complexity = 15

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"migrations/**/*.py" = ["D"]
"scripts/**/*.py" = ["T201"]
# Tests request pytest fixtures for their side effects and compare against literal expectations.
# Pytest passes parametrized booleans by keyword; FBT003 still guards positional call sites.
"tests/**/*.py" = ["ARG", "D", "FBT001", "PLR2004", "S101", "S105", "S106"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["gendertagger"]

[tool.ruff.lint.pydocstyle]
convention = "google"

[tool.ruff.format]
docstring-code-format = true
indent-style = "space"
line-ending = "lf"
quote-style = "double"

[tool.mypy]
enable_error_code = [
  "exhaustive-match",
  "ignore-without-code",
  "possibly-undefined",
  "redundant-expr",
  "truthy-bool",
  "truthy-iterable",
  "unused-awaitable",
]
exclude = ["^__scrap/"]
files = ["src", "tests", "scripts"]
namespace_packages = false
pretty = true
python_version = "3.11"
show_column_numbers = true
show_error_codes = true
strict = true
warn_unreachable = true

# Celery and kombu ship no py.typed marker; confine the untyped boundary to their imports.
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
ignore_missing_imports = true
module = ["celery.*", "kombu.*"]

# Classification-method dependencies ship no py.typed marker; confine
# the untyped boundary to their lazily imported adapter modules.
[[tool.mypy.overrides]]
ignore_missing_imports = true
module = [
  "gender_guesser.*",
  "nomquamgender.*",
  "unidecode.*",
  "transformers.*",
  "torch.*",
  "sklearn.*",
  "xgboost.*",
  "httpx2.*",
  "numpy.*",
  "statsmodels.*",
]

  "--strict-markers",

]

  # nomquamgender reads its bundled model with the legacy importlib.resources API on import.
  "ignore:open_text is deprecated:DeprecationWarning:nomquamgender",
]
markers = [
  "unit: fast tests isolated from infrastructure",
  "contract: serialized-schema and boundary contract tests",
  "scientific: normative or legacy-characterization behavior tests",
  "integration: tests spanning process or infrastructure boundaries",
  "postgres: tests requiring PostgreSQL",
  "postgres_rollback: audited db_session-only tests requiring proven outer rollback isolation",
  "redis: tests requiring Redis",
  "e2e: end-to-end workflow tests",
  "slow: tests excluded from the ordinary merge-request suite",
  "gpu: tests requiring a GPU runner",
  "external: tests requiring an explicitly enabled external service",
]
minversion = "9.1"
pythonpath = ["."] # Shared verification tooling lives in the backend scripts package.
testpaths = ["tests"]
xfail_strict = true

[tool.coverage.run]
branch = true
relative_files = true
source = ["gendertagger"]

[tool.coverage.report]
exclude_also = [
  "if TYPE_CHECKING:",
  "if __name__ == .__main__.:",
]
fail_under = 85
precision = 2
show_missing = true
skip_empty = true

[tool.coverage.xml]
output = "coverage.xml"

root_package = "gendertagger"

[importlinter]
root_package = neurodatics

# Lo permitido en este contrato: la analítica sí lee `modules.projects.domain.entities` (los modelos ORM
# `Project` y `ProjectFile`) para resolver propiedad del proyecto, sus archivos y la generación de caché
# vigente. Lo prohibido es depender de `modules.projects.application`, es decir de los casos de uso y
# servicios de ingesta: la analítica consume artefactos ya publicados, no dispara el procesamiento.
[importlinter:contract:analytics-processing]
name = Analytics must not depend on project application code
type = forbidden
source_modules =
    neurodatics.modules.analytics
forbidden_modules =
    neurodatics.modules.projects.application

# Las excepciones declaradas abajo: al publicar una generación nueva hay que invalidar lo derivado de la
# anterior, y hoy la ingesta llama directamente a las dos cachés de analítica para podarlas. La tercera
# entrada es el mismo cruce alcanzado de forma indirecta: la poda de medios pasa por
# `projects.infrastructure.video_preview_metadata`, que reutiliza `scope_to_scenario` de analítica. Si
# alguien quiere cerrar el cruce del todo, el camino es un puerto en `shared` que analítica implemente,
# como ya se hace con `storage_provider`.
[importlinter:contract:processing-analytics]
name = Project processing services must not depend on analytics
type = forbidden
source_modules =
    neurodatics.modules.projects.application
forbidden_modules =
    neurodatics.modules.analytics

    neurodatics.modules.projects.application.use_cases.upload_experiment_zip -> neurodatics.modules.analytics.infrastructure.parquet_cache
    neurodatics.modules.projects.application.use_cases.upload_experiment_zip -> neurodatics.modules.analytics.infrastructure.redis_cache
    neurodatics.modules.projects.infrastructure.video_preview_metadata -> neurodatics.modules.analytics.application.services.numeric_helpers

[importlinter:contract:shared-neutral]
name = Shared contracts must remain independent of feature modules
type = forbidden
source_modules =
    neurodatics.shared
forbidden_modules =
    neurodatics.modules

# include 는 .gitignore 규칙을 override - CI 에서 python -m build 가 .gitignore 의
# 'data/' 루트-미지정 패턴에 걸려 src/dartlab/*/data/ 를 wheel 에서 빠뜨리는
# packaging 사고 방어. artifacts 만으로는 불충분함이 실증됨 (2026-04-19).
include = [
    "src/dartlab/**/*.py",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.md",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.yaml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.yml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.json",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.toml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.parquet",
    "src/dartlab/**/py.typed",
]
artifacts = [
    "src/dartlab/ui/build/**",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.json",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.toml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.parquet",
    "src/dartlab/py.typed",
]
exclude = [
    "**/_reference/**",
    "**/_backup/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/edinet/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/esg/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/event/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/supply/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/watch/**",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.sdist]
# wheel include 와 동일 패턴으로 맞춰 산출물 drift 방지
include = [
    "src/dartlab/**/*.py",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.md",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.yaml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.yml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.json",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.toml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.parquet",
    "src/dartlab/**/py.typed",
    "src/dartlab/ui/build/**",
    "README.md",
    "LICENSE",
]
# ⚠ sdist 에도 artifacts 필수 (2026-07-26 사고 class). `python -m build` 는 sdist 를 먼저 굽고
# *그 sdist 를 풀어서* wheel 을 빌드한다. 그래서 sdist 에서 빠진 파일은 wheel 에서도 사라진다.
# `include` 는 positive filter 일 뿐이라 .gitignore(VCS) 배제를 이기지 못한다. .gitignore 에
# `src/dartlab/ui/build/` 가 추가된 순간(0.10.8~0.10.9) sdist 가 UI 를 통째로 떨궜고, PyPI wheel
# 0.10.9 의 dartlab/ui/** 가 0 개가 되어 데스크탑 런처가 "UI 빌드 파일(index.html) 없음" 으로
# 기동 불능이 됐다. VCS 배제를 이기는 유일한 키가 artifacts 다. wheel 타깃과 반드시 동기 유지.
artifacts = [
    "src/dartlab/ui/build/**",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.json",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.toml",
    "src/dartlab/**/*.parquet",
    "src/dartlab/py.typed",
]
exclude = [
    "**/_reference/**",
    "**/_backup/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/edinet/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/esg/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/event/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/supply/**",
    "src/dartlab/engines/watch/**",
]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py312"
line-length = 120
exclude = ["experiments", "*/_reference"]
# 도구 캐시는 루트 `.cache/` 한 곳에 모은다. 도구마다 루트에 제 폴더를 만들던 것이 루트 잡동사니의 원인이었다.
cache-dir = ".cache/ruff"

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "F", "I"]
# F401 = unused import - __init__.py 의 의도적 re-export 패턴이 dartlab 전반에 다수 (camelCase codemod 후 더 늘어남).
# 진짜 unused import 는 deptry / vulture 가 catch.
ignore = ["E402", "E501", "E741", "F841", "F401"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]
# ⚠ `--import-mode=importlib` 는 rootdir 을 sys.path 에 넣지 않는다. 그래서 spawn 자식이
# target 을 unpickle 할 때 `tests` 패키지를 못 찾고 ModuleNotFoundError 로 죽는다.
# 로컬 `python -m pytest` 는 CWD 가 sys.path[0] 이라 우연히 통과했고 CI 는 콘솔 스크립트라
# 실패했다. multiprocessing 은 부모 sys.path 를 preparation data 로 자식에 전달하므로
# 여기서 한 번 넣으면 두 경로가 같아진다. 제거하면 spawn 회귀 5 건이 CI 에서만 되살아난다.
pythonpath = ["."]
python_files = ["test_*.py", "test*.py", "bench_*.py", "bench*.py"]
python_classes = ["Test*"]
python_functions = ["test_*", "test*"]
addopts = "-v --tb=short --import-mode=importlib"
# 루트 `.pytest_cache/` 대신 도구 캐시 폴더 `.cache/` 아래에 둔다 (ruff cache-dir 과 같은 이유).
cache_dir = ".cache/pytest"
asyncio_mode = "auto"
# Hypothesis ghostwriter draft 폴더는 자동 수집 제외 - 명시 호출 시에만 실행.
# (`tests/_drafts/` 안 fuzz draft 는 사용자 review 후 정식 위치로 이동.)
# pytest default (`*.egg .* CVS _darcs {arch} dist node_modules venv`) + `_drafts` 추가.
norecursedirs = ["*.egg", ".*", "CVS", "_darcs", "{arch}", "dist", "node_modules", "venv", "_drafts"]
markers = [
    "requires_data: 로컬 parquet 데이터 필요 (CI에서 skip)",
    "unit: 순수 로직/mock만 - 데이터 로드 없음, 병렬 안전",
    "integration: Company 1개 로딩 필요 - 중간 무게",
    "heavy: 대량 데이터 로드 - 단독 실행 필수",
    "realData: 엔진별 실제 데이터 스모크 - HF parquet + 실제 파이프라인 실행 (schema drift/silent None 방어)",
    "freshInstall: 빈 캐시 → 자동 다운로드 경로 검증 (외부 사용자 첫 호출 시나리오)",
    "network: 외부 HTTP API 호출 (HF/DART/EDGAR/FRED) - transient 실패 재시도 대상",
    "slow: 실행 30초 이상 - PR fast path 에서 제외",
    # flaky 는 pytest-rerunfailures 가 설치된 환경에서 작동. 미설치 환경에선 무시.
    # 미등록 시 PytestUnknownMarkWarning - 본 항목으로 warning 차단.
    "flaky: transient 실패 자동 재시도 (pytest-rerunfailures)",
    # ghostwriter 자동 생성 draft (사용자 review 전) - `tests/_drafts/` 안 한정.
    "draft: Hypothesis ghostwriter 자동 draft - 정식 위치 이동 전 시범 검증",
    # AI agent eval - LLM 호출 + judge 채점. 운영자 트리거 또는 nightly.
    "eval: AI agent LLM 출력 회귀 (외부 API 호출, 비용 발생)",
    # mutation testing 메타 마커.
    "mutation: mutmut 대상 표시 - 잘못된 mutant 가 잡혀야 통과",
    # metamorphic - 변환 후 보존 속성 검증 (수치 분석에 oracle 부재 시).
    "metamorphic: 변환 후 속성 보존 (ranking shift, 단위 변환, 통화 환산)",
    # vcr - record-replay 카세트 사용 (외부 HTTP mock).
    "vcr: HTTP record-replay 카세트 사용 (네트워크 없이 회귀 검증)",
    # Phase A - ETL 단계 검증 (parquet row group sort + IPC mirror 빌더).
    "etl: ETL 산출물 검증 (parquet row group 메타, IPC mirror 동기성)",
    # Phase B/D - 메모리 회귀 가드 (RSS 측정).
    "memory: RSS 회귀 가드 - Company 1개 분석 시 peak RSS 검증",
    # T3-3 - pytest-xdist serial 강제. Company / OOM 위험 테스트는 단일 worker 에서만.
    "serial: pytest-xdist 병렬 제외 (Company 인스턴스 / Polars 힙 OOM 위험 / 전역 상태 변경)",
    # 마스터 플랜 v2 트랙 7 PR-M5 - MCP 출시 자동 smoke. CI Fast 에 등록.
    "mcpDogfood: MCP 출시 가드 - stdio + Streamable HTTP transport 통합 dispatch 검증",
]

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Mutation testing (mutmut) - Track 5
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 부분 적용: Polars/numpy native 호출 비중 큰 모듈은 mutant 의미 없음 (core/ 외 제외).
# 실행: uv run mutmut run    # 약 30-60 분
# 결과: uv run mutmut results
# 목표: mutation score ≥ 80%
[tool.mutmut]
# 패키지 실행 문맥은 전부 복사한다. 표적 파일만 복사하면 conftest의 import부터 실패한다.
source_paths = ["src/"]
# 기존 설정에서 실제 존재하던 표적을 보존한다. 폐기된 경로를 검사 범위로 세지 않는다.
only_mutate = [
    "src/dartlab/core/formatting.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/cache.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/naming/__init__.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/decimal.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/types.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/dataAudit.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/credentialLifecycle.py",
    "src/dartlab/core/plugins.py",
    "src/dartlab/analysis/financial/ratios.py",
    "src/dartlab/quant/portfolio/mapping.py",
]
# 변형된 소스의 구조 감사 대신 표적의 동작과 성질을 검증한다.
pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection = [
    "tests/core/test_formatting.py",
    "tests/core/test_cache.py",
    "tests/core/test_decimalContract.py",
    "tests/core/test_dataAudit.py",
    "tests/core/test_credentialLifecycle.py",
    "tests/core/test_pluginIntrospection.py",
    "tests/_strategies/test_formatting_property.py",
    "tests/_strategies/test_decimal_property.py",
    "tests/_strategies/test_dataaudit_property.py",
    "tests/_strategies/test_credential_property.py",
    "tests/_strategies/test_plugins_property.py",
    "tests/core/test_ratios_metamorphic.py",
    "tests/core/testRatiosContracts.py",
    "tests/core/test_ratiosNegativeEquity.py",
    "tests/core/test_ratiosDerivedCompleteness.py",
    "tests/core/test_ratiosCompleteness.py",
    "tests/reference/test_property_ratios.py",
    "tests/analysis/test_ratios_golden.py",
    "tests/analysis/test_insightEngine.py",
    "tests/analysis/test_valuation.py",
    "tests/metamorphic/",
    "tests/quant/test_l2_pure_functions.py",
    "-m", "unit and not network and not requires_data and not heavy and not realData and not freshInstall",
]
pytest_add_cli_args = ["-x", "--no-cov", "-q", "--benchmark-disable"]
# Polars 스레드를 초기화한 테스트 프로세스를 fork하지 않는다.
process_isolation = "forkserver"
forkserver_warmup = "none"

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["dartlab"]
# omit - coverage 90% 의 "90%" 는 "business logic 기준" 이 되도록 thin boundary /
# rendering / external-adapter / experimental 코드를 제외. 이 코드들은 realData
# smoke + wheel-smoke + integration 테스트로 간접 검증되거나 테스트 ROI 가 낮음.
omit = [
    # 기존 omit
    "src/dartlab/engines/ai/providers/*",
    "src/dartlab/review/*",

    # CLI - 얕은 argparse 래퍼. cli_e2e.py 가 핵심 경로 커버.
    "src/dartlab/cli/commands/*",
    "src/dartlab/cli/main.py",
    "src/dartlab/cli/parser.py",
    "src/dartlab/cli/rendering.py",
    "src/dartlab/cli/services/*",

    # 서버 API - HTTP 핸들러, realData end-to-end 로 간접 검증.
    "src/dartlab/server/api/*",
    "src/dartlab/server/web.py",

    # 외부 API 클라이언트 - 네트워크 의존, 모킹 ROI 낮음.
    "src/dartlab/providers/dart/openapi/*",
    "src/dartlab/providers/edgar/openapi/*",
    "src/dartlab/providers/edinet/openapi/*",

    # 메신저 어댑터 - Slack/Telegram/Discord SDK 모킹 ROI 낮음.
    "src/dartlab/channel/adapters/*",
    "src/dartlab/channel/devtunnel.py",

    # 시각화 - Plotly/차트 렌더링, snapshot 테스트 영역.
    "src/dartlab/viz/charts/*",
    "src/dartlab/viz/generators.py",
    "src/dartlab/viz/plotly.py",

    # 개발자 전용 - 사용자 미접근.
    "src/dartlab/ai/audit/*",
    "src/dartlab/mcp/*",

    # 얕은 display/AI helper 래퍼 - great_tables/IPython 옵셔널.
    "src/dartlab/viz/display/*",
    "src/dartlab/viz/network.py",

    # 실험/레거시 - 사용 여부 재평가 필요, 현재 0% 모듈.
    "src/dartlab/analysis/financial/research/*",
    "**/_reference/*",
    "**/_backup/*",
]

[tool.coverage.report]
show_missing = true
skip_empty = true
exclude_lines = [
    "pragma: no cover",
    "if __name__",
    "raise NotImplementedError",
]
# Coverage ratchet - omit 확대 후 추정 41.5% 기준 40 에서 시작.
# 경로 B (strategic omit + business logic 집중 테스트) 진행 중.
# 단계 계획: 40 → 50 → 60 → 70 → 80 → 90 (omitted-adjusted). PR 마다 하락 시 CI FAIL.
# CI 에서 `pytest --cov-fail-under` 플래그로 실제 강제.
fail_under = 40

[tool.pyright]
pythonVersion = "3.12"
typeCheckingMode = "basic"
include = ["src/dartlab"]
exclude = [
    "src/dartlab/engines/ai/providers/**",
    "ui/**",
    "experiments/**",
]
reportMissingTypeStubs = false
reportUnknownParameterType = false
reportUnknownMemberType = false
reportUnknownVariableType = false

[tool.bandit]
exclude_dirs = ["experiments", "tests"]
skips = ["B101"]

[tool.deptry]
# 옵셔널 통합 의존성 - 사용자가 별도 설치할 때만 동작 (런타임 ImportError 가드 있음)
extend_exclude = [
    "src/dartlab/.*/_reference/.*",  # 학습/실험 코드, 런타임 미사용
]
[tool.deptry.per_rule_ignores]
DEP001 = [
    # ── channel 어댑터 (외부 메신저 옵셔널) ──
    "discord", "slack_bolt", "telegram",
    # ── CLI 인터랙티브 옵셔널 ──
    "prompt_toolkit",
    # ── display 옵셔널 ──
    "great_tables", "itables", "IPython",
    # ── gather 옵셔널 ──
    "FinanceDataReader", "tavily",
    # ── _reference 학습/실험 ──
    "agents", "owlready2", "rapidfuzz", "edgar",
    # ── transitive deps (다른 패키지가 끌어옴) ──
    "dotenv",      # python-dotenv
    "google",      # google-genai
    "yaml",        # pyyaml
    "bs4",         # beautifulsoup4
    "starlette",   # fastapi가 끌어옴
    "pydantic",    # fastapi가 끌어옴
]
DEP002 = [
    "beautifulsoup4",  # bs4 직접 import
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "build>=1.4.0",
    "hatchling>=1.29.0",
    "hypothesis>=6.100.0",
    "import-linter>=2.0",  # tests/audit/cycleScan.py + pyproject [tool.importlinter] - 레이어 단방향 강제 (P0 가드)
    "libcst>=1.8.6",
    "networkx[default]>=3.0",  # scripts/build/buildIndustryMap.py - Kamada-Kawai+PageRank (default extra: scipy 포함)
    "pillow>=12.3.0",
    "pre-commit>=4.0.0",
    "pyright>=1.1.0",
    "pytest>=9.0.2",
    "pytest-asyncio>=0.24.0",
    "pytest-benchmark>=5.0.0",
    "pytest-cov>=6.0.0",
    "syrupy>=4.7.0",  # CLI 출력 (rich Console export_text) snapshot 동결 - 본 SSOT 통합 acceptance test
    "pandera[polars]>=0.29.0,!=0.32.0,<0.33",  # raw finance/report/docs frame 계약. gather endpoint silent drift 차단. 0.32.0 만 배제: polars 백엔드가 pa.Field(isin=...) 빌트인 체크를 등록하지 않아 class 정의 시점에 KeyError. 0.32.1 에서 수정 확인(2026-07-10 실측).
    "mutmut>=3.0.0",  # mutation testing - "테스트가 깨진 코드 잡나" 측정. core/ 한정 (Polars native 모듈 제외).
    "vcrpy>=6.0.0",  # HTTP record-replay - providers/dart, providers/edgar 외부 호출 회귀.
    "radon>=6.0.0",
    "rope>=1.14.0",
    "vulture>=2.0",
]

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Import-linter - 레이어 단방향 강제 + L2 양방향 cycle 차단 (P0 가드)
# ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 정책 SSOT: src/dartlab/skills/specs/operation/architecture.md
#   1. 상하 단방향: L0 ← L1 ← L1.5 ← L2 ← L2.5 dataHub ← L3 ← L4 (이 contract)
#   2. L2 동급 단방향 허용 (sibling import OK)
#   3. L2 양방향 순환 절대금지 (별도: tests/audit/cycleScan.py)
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

[tool.importlinter]
root_package = "dartlab"

# F4 강행 - contract 활성화 + 핵심 chain link 8 곳 importlib 변환.
# 잔존 위반 은 후속 0.10.x 에서 점진 inversion. 본 phase 는 가드 활성 + 기반 정리.
# CI fast 의 lint-imports step 은 continue-on-error(`|| pass`) - *의도된 advisory* (숨은 fail 아님).
# 레이어 단방향의 blocking SSOT = `tests/audit/dartlabGuard.py`(architecture-l0-l15 게이트, strict) +
# `cycleScan.py` + `tests/architecture/test_l2|l15_no_cross_import`(P1-7 에서 importlib 동적 import
# 탐지 추가). import-linter 는 transitive 가시화 보조 - 이중 가드라 advisory 유지가 정합.
# (debt-honesty P1-6 결정: blocking 전환 대신 advisory 명시 + stale ignore 정정)

# ── Contract 1: 상하 layer 단방향 (L2 는 exhaustive=false 로 제외, 별도 forbidden)
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "Layered architecture (L0~L1.5 + L2.5 dataHub + L3 + L4)"
type = "layers"
layers = [
    "dartlab.ai | dartlab.company",
    "dartlab.story",
    "dartlab.dataHub",
    "dartlab.scan",
    "dartlab.gather",
    "dartlab.core",
]
exhaustive = false  # L2 5 엔진은 이 contract 에서 무시 (sibling 단방향 허용)
ignore_imports = []  # 후속 정리 - 진행하며 한 줄씩 비움

# ── Contract 1b: L0~L1.5 완료 게이트 전용 (tests/architecture 와 동일 범위)
[[tool.importlinter.contracts]]
name = "L0-L1.5 architecture boundary"
type = "layers"
layers = [
    "dartlab.scan | dartlab.frame | dartlab.synth | dartlab.reference",
    "dartlab.gather | dartlab.providers",
    "dartlab.core",
]
exhaustive = false
ignore_imports = []

# ── Contract 2: L2 가 상위 (L3/L4) import 금지 (direct only)
